The passage describes a virtual object machine learning system integrated into a messaging system to classify highly dynamic subjects, such as human hands or dogs. Because real-world training data is difficult to control and manually label across variations in pose, texture, and lighting, the system generates synthetic training data using rigged 3D models with metadata-tracked key points. A render engine programmatically varies model poses or gestures, surface textures, and environment variables—including spherical high-dynamic-range background images, lighting, and virtual camera placements—to create large sets of labeled training images. A machine learning engine trains classifiers, such as support vector machines or neural networks, on this synthetic data. The trained model is then applied to real image or video data to detect key points and classify object types and poses, supporting functions such as pixel masking and overlaying annotations on messages within a messaging architecture comprising client devices, server systems, and subsystems for ephemeral content, media collections, and image processing.

The court reversed the judgment and ordered a new trial, finding no special contract held the purchaser liable and the plaintiff never brought about the sale.

The paper proposes AI-Noether, an automated abductive reasoning system for scientific discovery that reconciles polynomial hypotheses with existing background theory. Given known axioms and a target polynomial hypothesis that is not derivable from them, the system generates candidate polynomial axioms that, when added or substituted, allow the hypothesis to be derived. It uses algebraic geometry: encoding equations into ideals and varieties, decomposing the solution set into irreducible components via primary decomposition, and testing generators through Gröbner basis elimination to find missing axioms. Tests on physical theories—including Kepler’s Third Law, the Hall Effect, and the Carrier-Resolved Photo-Hall effect—show near-complete recovery of single missing axioms and 25–60% recovery rates for pairs or triples of missing axioms. The work is limited to polynomial equations, and future extensions to ODEs or PDEs are suggested.

Dr Henry Leung of Nanyang Polytechnic has developed a method to convert coffee waste into biodegradable plastic using genetically modified Cupriavidus necator bacteria. The team has completed laboratory experiments begun in 2013 and is seeking industrial partners to commercialise the process within three to five years.

The Supreme Court of Iowa reversed a district court decision allowing Gary Kehde to recover unemployment benefits. The court held that the district court had jurisdiction because an application for administrative rehearing was not a prerequisite to judicial review under the applicable statute. However, it ruled that the district court erred in finding the Department abused its discretion by refusing to allow Kehde’s former employer to withdraw its protest after a hearing and decision had already been issued, since eligibility is determined by the facts of the case and the withdrawal would not alter them. The court further held that substantial evidence supported the Department’s conclusion that Kehde’s possession of a lit marijuana cigarette on company premises was willful and deliberate misconduct, properly disqualifying him from benefits under section 96.5(2). The case was remanded to the district court for entry of an order consistent with the opinion.

A regulation American football field measures 120 yards long by 53.3 yards wide (360 by 160 feet), covering about 1.32 acres, with 100 yards of open play between two 10-yard-deep end zones. To score a touchdown, a ball carrier must break the plane of the goal line with the ball, while pass catchers must show control and get one foot in bounds (two in the NFL). Yard lines are marked every yard with solid lines every five yards and numbers every ten yards. Hash marks vary by level—18 feet 6 inches apart in the NFL, 40 feet in college, and 53 feet 4 inches in high school—determining ball placement and offensive space. Sideline numbers sit 12 yards from the sideline in the NFL, 9 yards in college, and 6 yards in high school. Six-foot-wide sidelines run the perimeter, and coaches are typically restricted to the area between the 25-yard lines.

Industry-sponsored clinical trials have become excessively complex, increasing duration, costs, and burden on participants and staff. Merck undertook a "Lean Design" project, using Faro Health's Smart Design Tool to quantify impacts, to simplify Schedules of Assessment (SoAs). The method rebuilds SoAs from a minimal "Ground Zero" base, adding only assessments with plausible biological relevance, appropriate timing and frequency, and necessary sample sizes, while excluding routine clinical care and challenging copy-and-paste templating. Workshops applying these principles to six protocols identified major potential reductions in participant hours (4–47 per participant), staff time, and costs (e.g., nearly $120 million in one cardiovascular trial). Because most protocols were in late development stages, teams often adopted only some recommendations. The authors conclude that applying Lean Design earlier in protocol development, supported by real-time quantitative feedback, can substantially reduce unnecessary complexity, burdens, and costs. Merck has launched a company-wide initiative to implement these principles.

This patent application describes an improved non-occluding intravascular axial blood pump designed to reduce hemolysis and blood clotting. The pump comprises a cylindrical shroud with an inlet and outlet, an impeller, a centrally disposed motor sharing a central axis with the shroud and impeller, and pillars coupling the motor to the shroud. Design features to minimize shear stress include a trumpeted shroud with a larger inlet than outlet, a long inlet length, a long bare hub length, raked-back impeller leading edges, a desired shroud-to-blade clearance, matched impeller base and stator tip flare angles, and pillars angled to match the outlet blade angle. Intended for intravascular placement in the descending aorta for NYHA Class III–IVa heart failure patients, the device was optimized through iterative computational fluid dynamic simulations and in vitro testing across three development phases. Prototype P_31, identified as the optimal configuration, features an extended shroud of at least 9.3 mm or 1.5 times the inner diameter, pillars oriented at a 30° angle, and refined impeller geometry including an extended hub and improved blade angles. Relative to the initial reference design, the optimized prototype reduced maximum impeller shear stress by 150–200 Pa, maintained average impeller shear below 400 Pa up to 30,000 rpm, improved the Normalized Index of Hemolysis by 78% at 20,000 rpm, and maintained hydraulic output and pressure generation while increasing efficiency.

Objects of this size are considered harmless and typically disintegrate in the atmosphere, unlike larger asteroids that can cause significant damage. This study employs molecular dynamics simulations to examine radiation damage in pure niobium at 300 K over primary knock-on atom (PKA) energies of 1–75 keV, comparing machine learning (SNAP), EAM, FS-1, and FS-2 interatomic potentials. All potentials reproduce the general cascade process of defect production, recombination, and stabilization, but they differ in surviving defect numbers, clustering behavior, and morphology. Defect production follows a power-law energy dependence with a regime transition near 20 keV associated with subcascade formation. Vacancy clustering remains robustly high across all energies and potentials, while interstitial clustering increases with energy and varies by potential. EAM produces a balanced mix of 1/2⟨111⟩ loops and C15-like rings; FS-2 generates primarily extended 1/2⟨111⟩ dumbbells, crowdions, and dislocation loops, consistent with experimental observations; FS-1 and SNAP yield more compact or disordered clusters, with SNAP forming a high fraction of C15-like rings (up to nine atoms) that may evolve into 1/2⟨111⟩ or ⟨100⟩ loops. The findings underscore that potential choice strongly governs predicted damage structures and that newer potentials differ markedly from older classical potentials, which overproduce defects and predict incorrect self-interstitial ground states.

The Google Pixel Watch 4 is an outdoor smartwatch priced at $349 (41mm) or $399 (45mm), offering multi-day battery life, fast charging, 5ATM water resistance with manual water lock, dual-band GPS, and satellite communications for emergency services in the contiguous US with an active carrier plan. Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) often lack high-quality phenotype data due to costly measurement, invasive collection, or incomplete participation. Machine learning (ML)-assisted GWAS, which imputes missing phenotypes to increase sample size and statistical power, has grown in popularity, but the validity of its associations has not been rigorously evaluated. This study demonstrates that conventional ML-assisted GWAS approaches—which treat imputed phenotypes as observed and ignore imputation uncertainty—carry a high risk of pervasive false-positive associations. In a real-data benchmark for type 2 diabetes (T2D) in the UK Biobank, GWAS on imputed phenotypes exhibited an 81% replication failure rate relative to ground-truth GWAS, because predictors such as HbA1c are influenced by non-glycemic (erythrocytic) genetic pathways unrelated to T2D risk. The authors show theoretically and empirically that high imputation accuracy or genome-wide genetic correlation cannot guarantee valid SNP-level inference, as existing methods estimate a weighted sum of effects on observed and imputed phenotypes rather than the true genetic effect.

To address these limitations, the authors introduce Post-prediction GWAS (POP-GWAS), a statistical framework that combines summary statistics from three GWAS—observed phenotypes in labeled data, imputed phenotypes in labeled data, and imputed phenotypes in unlabeled data—to debias estimates on a SNP-by-SNP basis. POP-GWAS requires no assumptions about the imputation algorithm, variables used, or imputation quality; it provides unbiased estimates, well-calibrated type-I error, and is universally more powerful than GWAS restricted to observed phenotypes. It requires only GWAS summary statistics as input and is computationally efficient. Simulations and T2D benchmarking confirm that POP-GWAS controls false positives while identifying more true loci than conventional methods.

The authors apply POP-GWAS to bone mineral density (DXA-BMD) across 14 skeletal sites in the UK Biobank, conducting the largest such GWAS to date. POP-GWAS identified 188 independent loci, including 89 novel loci, representing a 39% increase over conventional GWAS on observed phenotypes. The analysis revealed skeletal site-specific genetic architecture, such as a head-specific association at the LGR5 locus, and showed that fracture risk has stronger genetic correlations with BMD at anatomically matched sites. The study concludes that POP-GWAS offers a valid, powerful, and statistically optimal solution for ML-assisted GWAS.

This article studies non-deterministic polynomial time over semirings through logical approaches. It defines semiring semantics for propositional logic (PL^=_K), first-order logic (FO^=_K), and existential second-order logic (ESO^=_K) with formula (in)equality atoms and constants from a semiring K. It introduces BSS_K machines, extending the Blum-Shub-Smale model to semirings, and defines the complexity class NP_K via non-deterministic polynomial-time BSS_K machines. The main contributions are analogues of Fagin’s and Cook’s theorems: it proves that ESO^=_K captures NP_K over positive and commutative semirings, and that the true existential theory of K is complete for the Boolean part of NP_K. A novel non-arithmetic reduction is introduced to generalize the connection between the Boolean part of NP over the reals and the existential theory of the reals to positive and commutative semirings.

The authors address the challenge of predicting and independently controlling the rheological properties of polymeric fluids, specifically Boger fluids, where varying design parameters such as polymer concentration (c), molecular weight (M), and solvent viscosity (ηs) typically couples changes in shear modulus (G0), relaxation time (τ), and first normal stress difference coefficient (ψ1). Using polyisobutylene dissolved in a mixture of polybutene and light mineral oil as a model system, they apply the Zimm model to characterize dilute solutions via small-amplitude oscillatory shear and rotational shear measurements. They experimentally determine power-law scaling relationships between the design parameters and the resulting viscoelastic properties, including a deviation factor δχ for ψ1. Unlike theoretical scaling predictions, the experimental data yield an invertible design matrix, enabling a systematic framework to prescribe fluid compositions that achieve target values for G0, τ, and ψ1 independently. The study validates this approach by fabricating fluids with controlled G0 and τ, as well as fluids with constant ψ1 but varied viscosity, confirming that the method successfully decouples fluid elasticity from viscous effects. The framework provides a practical means to design tailored dilute viscoelastic fluids for rheological studies.

Week 6 results left the top 15 of the Week 7 Idaho high school football rankings largely intact, as No. 1 Bishop Kelly and No. 4 Eagle survived close contests to stay undefeated. Research indicates that emergency docket decision speed correlates with the ideological direction of cases.

Horsell Lodge near Woking, Surrey offers residential and dementia care with bespoke plans. Residents may bring possessions. Verify suitability; the home provided this information without liability for errors. Report issues via About us email.

The Texas Monthly article "How Enron Blew It" details the company's rise from a traditional pipeline business to a Wall Street darling and trading colossus under Ken Lay and Jeff Skilling. Enron cultivated an aggressive, high-pressure culture that rewarded intellectual capital, immediate profits, and uncapped bonuses, while utilizing mark-to-market accounting and a harsh forced-ranking performance system. After dominating natural gas and expanding into electricity, broadband, water via Azurix, and online commodities, Enron saw its stock plummet amid backlash over California's energy crisis, a troubled Indian power plant, the imploding tech sector, and scrutiny of its accounting practices. Skilling resigned as CEO after six months, citing personal sacrifices, while Lay returned to the position, pledging to refocus on core energy assets and soften the company's cutthroat internal culture.

Euro zone stocks opened 2017 at their highest in over a year after manufacturing data showed the fastest growth in more than five years, though trade was thin due to New Year holidays across Asia, North America and Europe. Major indexes including the Euro STOXX 50, Italy's FTSE MIB, Germany's DAX and France's CAC hit multi-month highs. The euro fell against a strengthening dollar, buoyed by expectations of U.S. rate hikes and fiscal expansion. Lower-rated euro zone bond yields fell. An Islamic State attack in Istanbul had little market impact, though the Turkish lira slipped. Mason Brothers & Tarlin v. United States set dutiable value for Christmas tree ornaments exported from Germany in August 1938 and imported at Boston. A stipulation incorporating the Woolworth record led the court to find them freely offered in the Sonneberg-Lauscha district for domestic consumption and export. Dutiable value is per se unit invoice prices plus 3% social assessments and, when not included, packing, cases, containers, coverings, and other costs to ready for shipment. The appeal was dismissed for other merchandise.

Apple Inc. filed its Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 26, 2015. The California-based company (Commission File Number 001-36743) designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, including iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple Watch, and Apple TV, along with related software, services, and accessories. It manages business geographically through reportable segments: Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan, and Rest of Asia Pacific. In 2015, domestic net sales accounted for 35% and international for 65% of total net sales; direct and indirect distribution channels accounted for 26% and 74%, respectively. No single customer exceeded 10% of net sales in 2015, 2014, or 2013. Research and development expenses were $8.1 billion in 2015, $6.0 billion in 2014, and $4.5 billion in 2013. As of September 26, 2015, the company had approximately 110,000 full-time equivalent employees and 5,575,331,000 shares of common stock outstanding. Its common stock trades on NASDAQ under the symbol AAPL; the aggregate market value of voting and non-voting stock held by non-affiliates was approximately $709.9 billion as of March 27, 2015. The company paid $11.4 billion in dividends in 2015 and expects quarterly dividends of $0.52 per share, subject to Board declaration. The filing outlines extensive risk factors, including dependence on global economic conditions, intense competition, frequent product introductions, supply chain and manufacturing concentration with outsourcing partners primarily in Asia, single or limited source components, reliance on third-party digital content and developers, intellectual property litigation, regulatory and international trade risks, data protection obligations, and potential tax liabilities including a European Commission investigation of Ireland’s tax treatment of two Irish subsidiaries. The company settled certain legal matters in Q4 2015; in the Apple eBooks Antitrust Litigation, a District Court judgment against the company is under appeal, with damages to be determined by final adjudication following a June 2014 settlement agreement. The company owns or leases 25.6 million square feet of building space and 1,757 acres of land, with headquarters in Cupertino, California, and various domestic and international facilities and data centers.

This study used the Multi-ancEstry TRanscriptOme-wide analysis (METRO) method and FOCUS fine-mapping to identify genes associated with general cognitive function, white matter hyperintensities (WMH), and Alzheimer’s disease (AD) by integrating genotype and gene expression data from 1,032 African ancestry (AA) and 801 European ancestry (EA) participants in the Genetic Epidemiology Network of Arteriopathy (GENOA) with published GWAS summary statistics. Gene expression was measured from Epstein-Barr virus-transformed B-lymphoblastoid cell lines. The analysis identified 266 fine-mapped genes associated with general cognitive function, 23 with WMH, 69 with AD in EA, and 2 (APOE and PVRL2) with AD in AA. Prior to fine-mapping, ICA1L was the only gene overlapping between WMH and AD, while after fine-mapping TOMM40 overlapped between the two AD TWASs. Many identified genes were not previously reported in the original GWASs, and functional enrichment revealed pathways related to innate immunity, vascular dysfunction, neuroinflammation, amyloid-beta clearance, and neurofibrillary tangles. The authors suggest that downregulation of ICA1L may contribute to overlapping AD and vascular dementia neuropathology. Limitations include the use of blood-derived cell lines rather than brain tissue, METRO’s single-gene analytic approach, and reliance on primarily EA GWAS. The study is the first multi-ancestry TWAS of these neurocognitive outcomes and highlights the potential of cross-ancestry integration to identify therapeutic targets for dementia.

Average American worker pay rose 3-4%. Four Ohio presidents ranked in the top 100, led by University of Dayton's Daniel Curran at $2.4 million.

Tesla, Inc.’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2022, reported total revenues of $18.76 billion and net income attributable to common stockholders of $3.32 billion, compared to $10.39 billion and $438 million in the prior-year quarter. The company operates automotive and energy generation and storage segments and continues to face COVID-19-related supply chain disruptions, semiconductor shortages, and inflation. The email compiles news articles dated June 7, 2001, regarding Enron. Enron signed an agreement with Commonwealth Edison to supply 60 percent of 400 megawatts of power annually to Chicago and 47 suburban communities under Illinois deregulation. This study reports that hybrid immunity from SARS-CoV-2 vaccination combined with natural infection generates superior humoral responses compared to vaccination alone. Analyzing two cohorts with varied intervals between infection and vaccination, the authors found that longer exposure intervals—up to at least 400 days—were associated with significantly higher neutralizing antibody titers and improved cross-neutralization across variants including Alpha, Beta, Delta, and Omicron BA.1 and BA.2. Hybrid immunity increased spike-specific total antibody and IgG levels several-fold and yielded greater neutralizing potency indices. The strongest correlations were observed for full-length spike antibodies and neutralization of all tested variants, with the largest gains against more vaccine-resistant strains. While age and sex had weaker effects, the exposure interval was the dominant variable. The findings indicate that immune responses continue maturing for over a year after initial exposure and that delayed vaccination or breakthrough infection can substantially enhance antibody quantity and quality, supporting expanded vaccine access while cautioning against intentional infection.

Kansas City Chiefs defensive lineman Chris Jones acknowledged not giving maximum effort while watching Jacksonville Jaguars quarterback Trevor Lawrence score a game-winning touchdown, explaining he mistakenly believed the play was over and calling the incident a "teaching point" that "won't happen again." Jones clarified that he had deactivated his social media accounts before the game, not after, and stated that he does not run from criticism. He added that he has been focused on the Lions since Monday's loss.

DPI (UK), a Castle Donington-based aluminium frames and lightboxes manufacturer, has received over £12,200 from the Collaborate scheme. The grant will buy a new automated saw to produce larger panels in-house rather than importing them, reducing contract times and eventually creating jobs. Founded three years ago, the company grew 37% last year. Collaborate grants cover one-third of capital projects, ranging from £5,000 to £25,000; about one-third of its £1.2 million pot has been allocated.

Andrew W. Lo introduces MIT Sloan course 15.401, Finance Theory, aimed primarily at first-year MBA students. He argues that finance is the core of all business decisions and motivates the subject through the diverse careers of James Simons, Warren Buffett, and Jack Welch, who all succeeded through their understanding of financial principles. The course focuses on four components of the financial system—households, financial intermediaries, non-financial corporations, and capital markets—and addresses two fundamental challenges: asset valuation and asset management. Lo demonstrates price discovery through an in-class auction of an undisclosed item. The analytical framework relies on accounting concepts of stock and flow to evaluate corporate cash decisions, with time and risk as the central complicating factors. He introduces six foundational principles and outlines the course structure: valuation, risk, corporate finance applications, and a final lecture on market imperfections. Grading consists of attendance and participation (10%), a case study (10%), a midterm (25%), and a cumulative final (55%). No mandatory problem sets are assigned, but optional problems are provided, and the majority of exam questions will be drawn from them. He advises students to review lecture notes in advance, take personal notes, work problems both alone and in groups, and apply the concepts to their own financial decisions.

An ARDD report commended Jordan's legal response to the Syrian refugee crisis, noting internationally recognised legal sections at camps and coordination between government agencies, UNHCR, and legal aid providers to deliver free protection services and documentation. The study cited measures to enhance legal awareness and provider capacity, while identifying ongoing challenges including financial shortages, labour market access, and evolving needs. This patent application describes a system and method for responding to database queries by executing differentially private versions of the queries on private database systems. A hardware database privacy device, coupled to a private database, receives a client query and identifies a level of differential privacy, including privacy parameters such as epsilon and delta, along with the client's privacy budget. The system identifies data and operations corresponding to the query, modifies the operations based on the identified differential privacy level to produce a differentially private result set, and provides the result to the client. The differentially private security system includes a user interface, library, account management system, query handling engine, data integration module, and privacy system. The privacy system contains engines for various queries—including count, median, mean, variance, interquartile range, batch and stochastic gradient descent, random forest, histogram, model testing, synthetic database generation, and validation—which perturb outputs or processes using noise (e.g., Laplacian, Gaussian, Cauchy) or other modifications to satisfy definitions of differential privacy. The system also supports generating differentially private synthetic databases that preserve spatial relationships between entries, allowing clients to perform additional analysis while maintaining privacy.

TyreWatch, a predictive tyre management system, launched on 16 May at Harwell Innovation and Science Campus, Oxfordshire. The system issues maintenance or critical alerts based on analyzed trends, monitors vehicles after hours, and integrates with existing systems through open architecture. It aims to prevent roadside breakdowns, reduce fuel consumption and tyre wear, improve safety, and support autonomous commercial vehicle deployment.

The "Horns" offense uses double mid screens to isolate a star ballhandler against a Box & One defense, creating drive, pass-to-roller, or kick-out options. This study examined adrenal vessels in normal adult tissue and neoplasms to investigate their relationship to fibromuscular dysplasia (FMD) and segmental arterial mediolysis (SAM). Normal adrenal central veins exhibited asymmetrical longitudinal smooth muscle bundles with gapping media and disorganized elastic layers, morphologically indistinguishable from FMD. In adrenal cortical adenomas, arterial walls demonstrated hyalinization, CD68-positive macrophages, intimal fibroplasia, and myxoid or fibrinoid medial degeneration consistent with SAM. In pheochromocytomas, arteries were thin-walled with diminished muscular media, myxoid or fibrinoid degeneration, and intimal fibroplasia. Among 30 adrenalectomy specimens, these changes were confined to adrenal tissue and absent from surrounding arteries and fetal autopsy cases. The authors conclude that these findings support unifying FMD and SAM as a spectrum of a single entity and suggest that adrenal hormones or receptor signaling may represent a shared pathogenic mechanism underlying vascular smooth muscle abnormalities in these conditions.

A new study supports the advice that airplane passengers worried about catching a cold or flu should sit in a window seat and remain seated. Led by Emory University’s Vicki Stover Hertzberg and funded by Boeing, researchers tested 10 flights and used computer modeling to determine infection risks. They concluded that on average, only one person per 150 would be infected by a hypothetical sick passenger in an aisle seat. The study found that 80 percent of aisle passengers moved during flights compared to 62 percent in middle seats and 43 percent in window seats, and that the 11 passengers closest to an infected person face the highest risk. Outside researchers cautioned that the small study is difficult to generalize but acknowledged it provides novel data on disease transmission in aircraft.

The Supertrend indicator, created by Oliver Seban, is a trend-following technical analysis tool that signals trend direction, continuation, and reversals. It appears as a line on price charts: green and below price during uptrends, red and above price during downtrends, reversing when price crosses the prior period’s indicator value. The formula uses the median price and Average True Range (ATR) to create upper and lower bands, with default parameters typically set to an ATR period of 10 and a multiplier of 3.

A backtest on the S&P 500 over 60 years using weekly charts and default settings showed approximately a 67% win rate and a maximum drawdown of 24.6%, significantly lower than buy-and-hold’s 56.24%. The indicator is lagging, dynamically adjusts to volatility by widening or tightening based on market conditions, and is best suited for financial instruments that maintain long-term trends, particularly on weekly timeframes. While primarily trend-following, it can be adapted for ranging or intraday markets with parameter adjustments. It can be combined with RSI, Moving Averages, or Bollinger Bands for confirmation. Limitations include potential false signals during choppy or high-volatility periods, and its effectiveness varies by market conditions, asset class, and timeframe.

Nathan Calvin, general counsel of the three-person AI policy nonprofit Encode, accused OpenAI of using intimidation tactics against critics of California’s SB 53 AI safety law. He alleged the company used its lawsuit against Elon Musk as a pretext to serve subpoenas on him and Encode in August, demanding private communications about the bill and implying secret Musk funding, which Encode denies. OpenAI head Justin Achaim and former board member Helen Toner expressed concern over the alleged tactics, while The Midas Project founder Tyler Johnston reported receiving a similar subpoena. OpenAI chief strategy officer Jason Kwon defended the subpoenas as standard litigation and questioned Encode’s funding transparency. SB 53, signed in September, requires frontier AI developers to publish safety frameworks and risk assessments. Calvin claimed OpenAI sought to weaken the bill by pushing exemptions for companies with federal or international safety agreements. Encode formally refused to provide documents, and Calvin called the episode inconsistent with OpenAI’s nonprofit mission.

In *D.L. Cromwell Investments, Inc. v. NASD Regulation, Inc.*, plaintiffs, who were targets of a federal grand jury investigation, sought an injunction to bar NASD Regulation from compelling their testimony in a disciplinary investigation concerning Pallet Management Systems, punishing them for asserting their Fifth Amendment privileges, and misusing federal grand jury materials. They contended that NASD Regulation acted as an agent of federal prosecutors. The court found that although NASD Regulation’s Criminal Assistance Prosecution Unit (CPAG) assisted the government, its Division of Enforcement (DOE) conducted an independent investigation. It held that the Rule 8210 demands for interviews were not the product of government coercion or suggestion, and therefore NASD Regulation was not a “state actor” subject to Fifth Amendment constraints. The court further found no credible proof that materials protected by Federal Rule of Criminal Procedure 6(e) were disclosed to or used by unauthorized personnel. The court denied the injunction but noted that the physical and administrative overlap between CPAG and the DOE created doubt about the DOE’s independence, which NASD Regulation should address.

The President transmits to Congress a message on the state of the Union and recommendations. The country is at peace, public health is at a high level, and private and state relief efforts are addressing winter distress. The worldwide economic depression has continued, but emergency measures saved the nation from disaster and conditions began improving in July. The President recommends continuing these measures until the depression passes, then liquidating emergency agencies. He identifies three necessities for recovery: reducing government expenditures and balancing the Federal Budget, immediately reorganizing the banking system to end widespread failures and credit strangulation, and cooperating with foreign nations through world disarmament and economic conferences to restore stability and commodity prices. The proposed budget reduces appropriations by over $830 million, limits new public works to existing commitments, continues the federal furlough system, imposes temporary salary reductions on officials earning over $1,000, cuts certain veterans' payments, extends manufacturers' excise taxes broadly at a uniform rate, and consolidates executive agencies. Banking reforms should avoid currency inflation or government operation of banks. The United States will not suspend European war debt payments due December 15 but will address exchange difficulties. The message concludes by affirming the government's role as a regulator rather than a participant in economic life, emphasizing individualism, voluntary cooperation, and adherence to spiritual traditions.

A Case Western Reserve University study in The Journal of Family Violence estimates the federal government spends $55 billion annually on the effects of childhood exposure to domestic violence. Exposed children face higher health-care costs, crime rates, and lower productivity, with an average lifetime cost of nearly $50,000 per person by age 64. An estimated 15.5 million U.S. children are exposed annually, and over 25 percent experience domestic violence in their lifetime. The study is the first to quantify the economic burden, which researchers hope will inform policymaker decisions on preventive and therapeutic interventions.

The Physical Layer Simplified Specification Version 6.00 for SD Memory Cards, released by the SD Card Association, states that adoption referencing SD Specifications versions 1.0 or 1.01 requires obtaining appropriate licenses from SD-3C, LLC, and is provided on a non-confidential, "AS-IS" basis without warranties or liability. In Hogg's Estate, the court considered whether a testator's gift of principal to "grandchildren" per stirpes included children of afterborn children. The majority, per Bok, J., held that the unambiguous term "grandchildren" encompassed all grandchildren, including those of afterborn children, and that heirs cannot be disinherited without express words or necessary implication; the exceptions were dismissed and the account confirmed. Steakne, J., dissenting, joined by Sinkler, J., argued the testator intended "grandchildren" to refer only to the issue of his four named children, as the afterborn children were not contemplated, had already received intestate shares, and the majority's interpretation produced an inequitable distribution; he would sustain the exceptions.

The document is the AMD SEV-ES Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) specification agreement and technical standard. It establishes a legal agreement between AMD and the recipient regarding use of the specification, feedback, and intellectual property rights, and includes disclaimers and export control provisions. Technically, it defines the GHCB protocol for Secure Encrypted Virtualization-Encrypted State (SEV-ES) and Secure Nested Paging (SEV-SNP), which protect guest register state from the hypervisor. The GHCB is a 4KB decrypted shared memory page used during Non-Automatic Exits (NAE) to exchange state between guest and hypervisor via the VMGEXIT instruction. The specification details protocol versioning, hypervisor feature advertisement through a bitmap, GHCB establishment via MSR protocol and GPA registration, and negotiation examples. It documents standard and specific NAE events, including IOIO_PROT, MSR_PROT, MMIO, Page State Change, SNP Guest and Extended Guest Requests, SNP AP Creation, #HV doorbell/IPI/timer, APIC ID List, SNP Run VMPL, SNP TIO Guest Request, Secure AVIC, and Termination Requests. It also covers guest identification of SEV-ES support, SMP booting procedures for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP, NMI handling, debug register virtualization, and SNP Restricted Injection with hypervisor doorbells. System Management Mode and nested virtualization are not supported.

The Dogs of the Dow (DOD) strategy selects the 10 highest dividend-yielding stocks from the 30 components of the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) and rebalances the portfolio annually at the beginning of each year, investing equal dollar amounts in each. The authors developed COVIDFast, an RNA extraction-free RT-qPCR assay for rapid, high-throughput SARS-CoV-2 detection in anterior nares swabs (SwabFAST) or saliva (SalivaFAST). Conventional PCR requires nucleic acid extraction, which is laborious, costly, and a diagnostic bottleneck. COVIDFast uses proprietary buffers—viral transport buffer (VTB) with Tris-Borate-EDTA for swabs and a Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine-based buffer for saliva—combined with proteinase K digestion to enable direct-to-PCR testing. The system employs uniform 2 mL bar-coded cryovials and compatible automated decappers and pipetting equipment to facilitate high-throughput processing. VTB remained stable across multiple temperatures and durations. Analytical validation demonstrated equivalent qualitative and quantitative results between extraction-free and extraction-based methods, with a limit of detection of 4 copies/µL for both specimen types. Clinical validation against extraction-based methods showed 100% positive and negative percent agreement (PPV/NPV) for swabs and 98.8% PPV/99.4% NPV for saliva. Compared to SalivaDirect, SwabFAST showed 83.3% PPV and 99.4% NPV, while SalivaFAST showed 95% PPV and 100% NPV. Since launch, 409,883 tests were performed by December 23, 2021, with 83.62% swab tests and an overall 8.10% positive rate. The assay achieves 24-hour turnaround at volumes exceeding 5,000 per day, reducing material costs, labor, and contamination risk while maintaining accuracy.

San Francisco and Los Angeles price gains exceeded expectations based on employment data.

FULE erases the full user area via CMD32 (arg 0), CMD33 (end), and CMD38 (00000002h). Hosts must check FULE_SUPPORT in SD_STATUS. Sequence errors set ERASE_SEQ_ERROR or ERASE_RESET. Without full range, card performs ERASE. FULE supports SDHC/SDXC only, not SPI, and indicates progress by holding DAT0 low.

Outgoing Fed Chair Yellen, leaving Saturday and replaced by Jerome Powell, said she would not label Wall Street gains a bubble but warned investors to remain cautious. She called the US economy strong, citing 200,000 January jobs and 4.1 percent unemployment, and was disappointed not to get a second term.

Coach Quenneville discussed his team's playoff experience, emphasizing preparation and focusing on each shift without getting ahead. He noted the long journey through a competitive division and tough series, praising the team's resilience and depth, with players stepping up at critical times. He highlighted top players, including Hossa, for consistent production and elevating teammates. Quenneville said the team has evolved over seasons while maintaining a team-first, accountable approach, and he will not alter preparation or mindset for upcoming games, stressing the importance of quickness and strong starts.

This study proposes a DNN-Transformer-Autoencoder hybrid framework for corporate tax risk supervision and risk-level assessment. The model combines a Deep Neural Network for static enterprise features, a Transformer for temporal financial dependencies, and an Autoencoder for anomaly detection via reconstruction error; their outputs are fused to classify enterprises as high, medium, or low risk. Evaluated on a real-world dataset of approximately 12,000 enterprises across multiple industries, the proposed model outperforms Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and DNN-LSTM baselines, achieving 0.91 accuracy, 0.86 recall, and 0.88 F1. Training and validation loss curves demonstrate stable convergence and strong generalization. The authors note limitations in omitting macroeconomic and inter-firm relationship data and in high computational complexity, suggesting future work to integrate such features and develop more interpretable, lightweight models.

In *Betteys v. Aetna Life Insurance Co.*, the court reversed a judgment for plaintiff Hannah Betteys, beneficiary of her husband’s accident policy, and granted a new trial. The court held that letters from the insurer and its agents were admissible regarding waiver of proof of death within 60 days, but defendant’s denial of liability and recall of proof blanks excused plaintiff from making proof. However, defendant’s denial of death liability and offer to consider only a disability claim did not estop it from invoking the policy’s time limit for suit on the death benefit. Seeking proofs and encouragement from an agent did not waive the suit limitation, and waiver of the time to make proof did not waive the time to bring action. Because plaintiff did not sue within the contractual period after the June 1918 denial, the death benefit claim was barred, entitling defendant to a directed verdict on that claim, while the weekly indemnity claim required a new trial.

The passage specifies SD Memory Card Physical Layer Simplified Specification Version 6.00 requirements, covering CMD19 tuning block execution for UHS-I timing optimization; card identification and data transfer mode state transitions using commands such as CMD7, CMD9, and CMD4; data read, write, and erase operations including abort conditions, busy signaling, block length constraints, and partial block handling. It details Erase, Discard, and Full User Area Logical Erase (FULE) command sequences and write protection methods. It defines CMD42 password lock/unlock procedures and Card Ownership Protection (COP), including Force Erase and FEP Force Erase behaviors. It addresses ACMD6 bus width selection, CMD6 switch function capabilities for bus speed, command system, driver strength, and power limit, plus CMD8 supply voltage verification. Functional differences between SDSC and SDHC/SDXC memory access addressing are explained. Finally, it describes CRC7 and CRC16 protection, clock stop requirements, illegal command handling, and read, write, and erase timeout conditions.

The FMA raised its Heta Asset Resolution asset sale forecast to 8.6 billion euros, a 2.6 billion euro increase benefiting the state which loaned Carinthia funds for a bond buyback. It expects an initial payment of about 4 billion euros to creditors, with Carinthia the largest, over the summer.

The Value Area trading strategy uses the volume profile to identify the price range where approximately 70% of trading volume occurred during a specific period, representing the price level where most units of an asset were traded. Traders use these levels to identify support and resistance, generate signals from breakouts, reversals, and pullbacks, and adjust stop losses and profit targets. While applicable across futures, stock, and forex markets on various timeframes, the strategy carries risks of false signals and outdated information, requiring risk management techniques such as stop-loss orders and position sizing. The authors note that backtesting this strategy is difficult and decline to perform one.

This study investigates the orbital degree of freedom (ODF) in hybrid magnon–phonon systems, addressing the poorly understood role of phonon pseudo-orbital angular momentum and its conversion with magnon ODF. The authors demonstrate that in magnon-polarons, the ODF originates from the quantum geometry of Bloch wavefunctions—specifically the self-rotation of wavepackets—rather than solely from global lattice rotation, establishing a formalism applicable to both bosonic and fermionic systems. Using a model of a two-dimensional honeycomb antiferromagnet with Néel order and magnetoelastic coupling (e.g., MnPS₃), they show that hybridization enables the transfer of intra-band and inter-band orbital angular momentum between magnons and phonons by breaking combined parity-time symmetry. Consequently, out-of-plane phonon modes acquire finite orbital angular momentum and magnetic moment. The study predicts that this orbital angular momentum, alongside spin Berry curvature, generates a measurable transverse voltage under temperature or strain gradients, with the orbital contribution dominating at low magnetic fields and enhancing electric polarization by several orders of magnitude compared to uncoupled systems. These findings lay the theoretical foundation for phonon orbitronics and a unified framework for harnessing the orbital degree of freedom in condensed matter.

Scientists are preparing to study a total solar eclipse crossing the U.S. from Oregon to South Carolina using ground-based instruments, the International Space Station, satellites, aircraft, and high-altitude balloons. The federal government is spending approximately $7.7 million on research examining the sun's corona, Earth and space weather, and biological reactions. Citizen scientists are participating through projects including high-altitude balloon footage, the Citizen CATE telescope network, animal observation via the iNaturalist app, and UC Berkeley's Eclipse Megamovie. Astronomers emphasize that eclipses provide unique opportunities to observe the sun's outer atmosphere, which is otherwise obscured by its brightness. Historical discoveries from eclipses include the identification of helium in 1868 and confirmation of Einstein's theory of general relativity in 1919.

The study investigates equilibrium vacancy concentrations in a nine-component refractory multi-principal element alloy composed of periodic table groups 4, 5, and 6 elements. An embedded cluster expansion model parameterized with first-principles calculations was used to reproduce ordering energetics, and a coarse-graining formalism was extended to compute finite-temperature equilibrium vacancy concentrations within the canonical ensemble using canonical Monte Carlo simulations. Results show that adding group 4 elements increases vacancy concentrations by a factor of 10–100 relative to alloys containing only groups 5 and 6, yielding concentrations near 10⁻⁴ at approximately 1700 K in certain compositions. Equilibrium vacancy concentrations exhibit Arrhenius-like behavior and strong dependence on short-range order and bonding energies. Local elemental segregation around vacancies aligns with dilute solute-vacancy binding preferences. The coarse-graining approach was validated against semi-grand canonical Monte Carlo simulations. The study also finds that special quasi-random structure approximations underestimate vacancy concentrations by neglecting short-range order and finite-temperature chemical potential effects. The framework enables composition tuning to target vacancy concentrations for processability, though group 4 content must be balanced against risks of degraded high-temperature properties, increased interstitial uptake, and phase transformations.

In Waterhouse v. Gibson, the court held that a conveyance by extent is construed under the same rules as a conveyance by deed, and an execution on a debtor's land conveys all buildings on it regardless of foundation depth. Parol evidence is inadmissible to show buildings were reserved by mutual consent when the execution returns contain no exception. The defendants removed a barn and shop from land the plaintiff purchased from the execution creditor. The court rejected the defendants' offered parol evidence that the buildings were excluded from the extent, ruling that because the debtor owned both the land and buildings, they passed to the creditor under the levy, and exceptions allowing tenants to remove trade fixtures did not apply to an owner. Judgment on the verdict for the plaintiff was entered.

A Danish study found children of mothers with rheumatoid arthritis face higher risks of rheumatoid arthritis, thyroid disease, and epilepsy. Analyzing 25 years of Danish births including over 2,100 children of affected mothers and 1.3 million unaffected, researchers urge doctors to monitor development in children exposed in utero.

Microsoft Corporation filed its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2020, reporting total revenue of $35.0 billion, net income of $10.8 billion, and diluted earnings per share of $1.40. Total assets were $285.4 billion, stockholders’ equity was $114.5 billion, and cash and cash equivalents were $11.7 billion. Revenue by segment was $11.7 billion for Productivity and Business Processes, $12.3 billion for Intelligent Cloud, and $11.0 billion for More Personal Computing. Commercial cloud revenue grew 39% to $13.3 billion, driven by a 59% increase in Azure revenue, 47% growth in Dynamics 365, and 25% growth in Office 365 Commercial. The company stated that COVID-19 had minimal net impact on quarterly revenue, though it increased demand for cloud and remote work solutions while reducing advertising spend in LinkedIn and Search. The effective tax rate was 16%, long-term debt was $62.9 billion, and as of March 31, 2020, $36.8 billion remained available under a $40.0 billion share repurchase program approved in September 2019.

The IMF advised Saudi Arabia to slow reforms and price hikes to avoid harming growth, while praising its programme. The kingdom, facing a $53 billion shortfall this year after $200 billion in past deficits, targets budget balance by 2019, but the IMF recommends 2022. Austerity measures including excise taxes, utility price hikes, and expatriate labour fees have been introduced, with further hikes and a five-percent VAT planned. Overall GDP growth is expected near zero due to declining oil production.

The disclosure describes methods and apparatuses for video encoding and decoding that reconstruct a block using intra prediction and non-separable transforms. For a block coded with a directional mode, the directional mode is determined from a signaled nominal mode and angular offset, and a non-separable transform is determined based on the nominal mode, such as via an associated transform set mode and a signaled non-separable transform index. For a block coded with a non-directional mode—such as DC, PAETH, SMOOTH, SMOOTH_V, SMOOTH_H, recursive filtering, or chroma from luma—a non-separable transform is selected from a set associated with the mode to reconstruct the block. The non-separable secondary transform does not apply to at least the PAETH mode and recursive filtering modes.

A collection of education news headlines and brief descriptions from The 74 covering diverse topics including immigration enforcement, natural disasters, teacher achievements, vaping lawsuits, school meals, civil rights and integration, college access, STEM education, pandemic relief, language preservation, school spending, federal policy, youth accomplishments, and health updates.

The preliminary inquiry into the murder of South Road pensioners Phyllis Caesar and Constance Fraser continued before Principal Magistrate Judy Latchman. Four witnesses testified. Imran Khan, Steven Andrews, and Phillip Suffrien are accused of killing the women during a robbery. Khan and Andrews are unrepresented; Saphier Hussein represents Suffrien. The PI continues Monday.

This study examines the characteristics and employment patterns of Hungarian higher education lecturers since the post-socialist transition. After 1990, the system expanded from low capacity toward mass education, but this trend halted after 2010 when an illiberal, populist government adopted elitist, restrictive policies that reduced state support and enrollment. Student numbers fluctuated due to demographic shifts, the 2005 Bologna reform, tuition fee changes, and tightened admissions requirements. Lecturer numbers correlated strongly with student growth until 2004, then weakly negatively afterward; the student-teacher ratio peaked around 2006 and subsequently declined. Hungary’s academic staff is older than the OECD average though near the international middle range, and the proportion of women is rising but remains below leading countries.

Employment regulations evolved from Soviet-era centralized scientific qualifications to the 1993 Higher Education Act restoring university PhDs and creating a National Accreditation Committee. The 2011 Act reduced institutional autonomy, introduced the chancellor system, and in 2020 reorganized most state institutions into public foundations, replacing civil service status with labor-market employment and linking pay to performance evaluations for lecturers at these “model-changing” universities. Between 2005 and 2020, the number of university and college professors fell by two-thirds, driven by demographic retirements, funding cuts, stricter appointment requirements, and low salaries that lag behind public administration and business-sector incomes.

Lifetime earnings data indicate that Hungarian PhD holders in academia earn less over their careers than business-sector graduates and only slightly more than public-sector graduates, making academic careers financially disadvantageous. Hungary also ranks below 40th internationally in doctoral students per 100,000 inhabitants, raising concerns about future research and teaching capacity. The study concludes that restrictive policies, reduced autonomy, and poor compensation hinder the attraction and retention of academic staff, recommending that policymakers address educators’ conditions.

Azerbaijan aims to increase honey and beekeeping exports, Agriculture Minister Heydar Asadov said, citing rising global demand and the organic quality of Azerbaijani honey. The ministry will propose increased state support for beekeeping to the president and government.

A University of Maryland study of 1,099 students found energy drink consumption between ages 21 and 24 was linked to increased risk of later cocaine or prescription stimulant misuse. Persistent and occasional users showed heightened risk, though researchers did not explain why.

The Texas Education Agency is investigating teachers’ social media posts about conservative activist Charlie Kirk’s death. Commissioner Mike Morath condemned the comments as “reprehensible and inappropriate” and promised to refer posts to the agency’s investigative unit with recommendations that instructors have their teaching licenses suspended. Governor Greg Abbott supported the move, accusing teachers of inciting violence. Legal experts and public education advocates say the probe violates educators’ First Amendment rights, noting that public school employees retain free speech protections when speaking in their personal capacity. They argue the state would need to prove significant workplace disruption to justify disciplinary action, and they warn the investigation amounts to a politically motivated “witch hunt” that could chill speech. The Texas American Federation of Teachers criticized the inquiry, saying firing teachers over such comments is inappropriate.

The Business Insider Scottish Accountancy & Finance Awards annually recognise accountants in the private and public sectors. The 2018 event is presented by Sarah Heaney with entertainment by DNA. Categories include firm, director, and team awards. Tickets cost £132 to £1,440 plus VAT, including a drinks reception, dinner, and entertainment.

Marc Ó Sé says an injury-free James O'Donoghue will be a huge boost for Kerry after he scored nine points on his return against Clare, and that his confidence will improve with each game if he stays injury-free.

Bond trading strategies offer portfolio diversification and uncorrelated returns. The article examines backtested U.S. Treasury bond strategies using the TLT ETF, including seasonal and swing-trade systems. Adding these bond strategies to an S&P 500 bundle raised annual returns from 11.5% to 18.6% and reduced drawdowns. Bond prices move inversely to interest rates, a relationship central to trading decisions. Day trading bonds is difficult due to lower volatility and macro sensitivity, with traders typically focusing on liquid government securities. Strategies can be automated via algorithms but require human oversight. Beginners may use dollar-cost averaging. Common mistakes include neglecting risk management, overrelying on historical data, chasing yield, misjudging rates, and emotional biases. Strategies vary by time horizon, risk tolerance, and market conditions.

The speaker fondly recalls Detroit, their first team, where they reached the semi-finals twice. They were excited to be traded to Washington but noted the trade did not work out and the team struggled, though they believe in the team. They cherish memories of teammates Steve and Kocur, state their first trade was a shock, and say playing on the road may help avoid being too excited.

Enron Corp. is in advanced discussions to sell its Portland General Electric utility unit to Northwest Natural Gas Co. for approximately $1.8 billion in cash and stock, with Northwest Natural assuming roughly $1 billion in debt; some reports place the total transaction value at about $2.8 billion. The highly leveraged deal, which would leave Enron with a minority stake in Northwest, remains at a delicate stage and faces financing hurdles, though an agreement could be announced within days. It follows the earlier collapse of Enron’s planned sale of the utility to Sierra Pacific Resources. Northwest Natural confirmed the discussions and separately announced an increase in its quarterly common dividend to 31.5 cents per share.

Enron also plans to eliminate about 500 jobs, or up to 10 percent of its European workforce, in a cost-cutting move.

Separately, BG Group PLC’s planned $388 million acquisition of Enron’s stake in two Indian offshore oil and gas fields is in jeopardy because field partners ONGC and Reliance Industries are challenging BG’s acquisition of operatorship, which BG has set as a condition; a decision is expected by late October.

In addition, India’s Tata Power Co. is preparing a bid for Enron’s 65 percent stake in the troubled Dabhol Power Co., a $2.9 billion project shut since June amid payment disputes with its sole buyer. Tata Power expects to finalize its offer within three weeks. Indian lenders are seeking a discounted equity price and concessions to revive the project, while BSES Ltd. has declined to participate. A Moody’s analyst noted that Tata Power’s interest is logical but stressed that the project must be financially self-sustaining.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K on July 1, 2020, announcing that Frank H. Brod will retire as Chief Accounting Officer on July 31, 2020, and remain through September 30, 2020, to assist in transition. Alice L. Jolla, age 54, Corporate Controller since 2014, will become Chief Accounting Officer effective July 31, 2020. She will receive a $1.5 million stock award under the 2017 Stock Plan, vesting 6.25% quarterly subject to continuous employment.

President Trump criticized ABC CEO Bob Iger for apologizing to Valerie Jarrett after canceling "Roseanne" over Roseanne Barr's racist tweet, while not apologizing to Trump for statements about him on ABC. Iger previously clashed with Trump over climate and immigration policies. Democratic lawmakers criticized Trump. Jarrett confirmed Iger's call, called the incident a teaching moment, and said presidential tone sets an example while urging citizens to push back.

Researchers from MIPT and the Russian Academy of Sciences have determined how polypropylene molecular regularity and thermal treatment affect mechanical properties, enabling synthesis of material with predetermined elasticity or hardness. Published in Polymer, the study found that higher isotacticity—measured by pentad content—produces more crystallites and stronger material. The team tested samples with 25 to over 95 percent isotacticity, prepared by quenching or slow cooling, and found that mechanical behavior depends on both isotacticity and thermal history. They concluded that controlling molecular structure during synthesis determines the material's final properties.

Bitcoin fell below US$8,000 for the first time since November before recovering, continuing its 2018 decline amid regulatory threats, a US$500 million Coincheck heist, and Facebook’s ad ban. Rival cryptocurrencies tumbled. Analysts warned of further losses, while Nouriel Roubini called bitcoin a bursting bubble and said G20 nations are discussing crackdowns.

Wal-Mart Stores Inc's bid for clothing retailer Bonobos marks its fourth acquisition of a small online clothing-and-accessories brand since the start of 2017, part of e-commerce chief Marc Lore's strategy to compete with Amazon and attract millennial shoppers. Despite being the world's largest brick-and-mortar clothing retailer with 2016 sales exceeding $23 billion, Wal-Mart's online sales account for only about 3 percent of total revenue. The company previously acquired ShoeBuy, Moosejaw, and ModCloth, and targets 20 to 30 percent online sales growth. However, some retail consultants question whether these small deals can effectively challenge Amazon, which leads the U.S. online clothing and footwear market with $13 billion in 2016 sales.

Materials modeling of disordered systems requires atomistic structures matching experiment, but standard Monte Carlo (MC), molecular dynamics (MD), and reverse MC methods often fail to guarantee experimental agreement or suffer from poor scaling, unphysical artifacts, and inefficiency. Recent machine-learning hybrid reverse MC improves accuracy but remains inefficient. Prior MD-based attempts to match experimental data had scaling limitations, inaccurate gradients, and omitted thermal effects. This article introduces molecular augmented dynamics (MAD), an O(N) modified MD method optimizing experimental agreement and system energy via a Hamiltonian combining kinetic energy, an interatomic potential, and an experimental potential. The work derives analytic, linearly scaling forces for X-ray diffraction, neutron diffraction, pair distribution functions, and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy observables, incorporating thermal broadening for efficient, ab-initio accurate structure determination.

The JACL Kakehashi Program will send up to 200 Japanese American or Asian American students and young professionals aged 18–25 on nine-day trips to Japan in December and March. Applications are due October 9 and January 2, 2018; Japanese nationals are ineligible.

Weekly tips include: adding rare earth magnets to tester wires for quick hookups; using an old motor as a rotating video turntable; fitting a hobby knife to a compass; marking untrue material edges with squiggly lines; converting a drill press into a drum sander; and using a ten-dollar Ikea flexi-neck LED lamp for workbench lighting.

The United States and China share interests in peace, bilateral trade, and opposing Soviet military buildup, though they disagree on Taiwan. A Reagan-Bush Administration would follow guiding principles for the Far East: pursuing a global, strategic U.S.-China partnership and expanding trade, scientific, and cultural ties; promoting peace, stability, and economic growth in the Western Pacific with Japan, the People’s Republic of China, the Republic of Korea, and Taiwan; resisting aggression and hegemony; and conducting U.S.-Taiwan relations under the Taiwan Relations Act. The Act, which Congress designed to remedy inadequate Carter-era legislation, safeguards Taiwan by providing defensive weapons, resisting force or coercion, and administering relations through the American Institute in Taiwan under Congressional funding and oversight.

Best Hope Services will launch Nigeria's first online trade exhibition on May 1 to promote local innovations. CEO Olu Adenodi said the e-fair allows global showcasing and remote participation without physical venues. Prof. Joseph Mba said it will foster national development and inspire creativity. Nigerians are urged to register beforehand.

The NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU is based on the NVIDIA Ampere architecture (GA100) and fabricated on TSMC’s 7nm process to accelerate AI, HPC, and data analytics workloads in cloud data centers. It introduces third-generation Tensor Cores supporting TF32, FP16, BF16, FP64, INT8, INT4, and binary formats, along with fine-grained structured sparsity that doubles throughput. Compared to the Tesla V100, A100 delivers substantial performance gains, including 2.5x speedups for FP16/FP32 mixed-precision and 10x for TF32 operations. The GPU includes 40 GB of HBM2 memory with 1555 GB/sec of bandwidth and a 40 MB L2 cache featuring residency controls and compute data compression. Its Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) capability securely partitions a single A100 into up to seven isolated GPU Instances for multi-tenant use. Third-generation NVLink provides 600 GB/sec of total GPU-to-GPU bandwidth, while PCIe Gen 4 and SR-IOV improve host connectivity and virtualization. The A100 enhances error and fault detection, isolation, and containment; adds hardware-accelerated NVJPG and NVDEC decode engines; and supports CUDA 11 features including Task Graph acceleration, asynchronous copy, asynchronous barriers, and Cooperative Groups. These technologies are integrated into the NVIDIA DGX A100 system, which combines eight A100 GPUs for scalable AI infrastructure.

The Housing Authority of the City of Santa Barbara received a Gold Nugget Award for Best Affordable Project at the Pacific Coast Builders Conference for Bradley Studios, a 54-unit development built in 2012. The project houses low and extremely low-income residents with special needs and offers on-site social services. Judges praised its California Craftsman style and innovative, community-minded design.

Cutaneous leishmaniasis (CL) involves immune checkpoints IDO1 and PD-L1 (CD274) expressed by myeloid cells that regulate T cell effector function and treatment response. Using Visium spatial transcriptomics, CosMx single-cell imaging, and immunohistochemistry on lesion biopsies from Sri Lankan, Brazilian, and Indian patients, this study mapped the cellular niches containing IDO1+ and PD-L1+ myeloid cells. IDO1 and CD274 localized to myeloid-rich regions in the papillary dermis and deeper T cell-rich areas, with mature dendritic cells (DC3) and CCL18+ macrophages showing the highest transcript abundance. Neighbourhood analysis identified consistent interactions between IDO1+/CD274+ myeloid cells and CD8+ memory T cells, regulatory T cells (Tregs), and CCL18+ macrophages. IL-32, expressed by CD8+ T cells and Tregs, was a common spatial correlate of IDO1 and CD274 expression; IL-32β and IL-32γ were the most highly upregulated isoforms in lesions. Across Sri Lankan L. donovani CL, Brazilian L. braziliensis CL, and Indian post–kala-azar dermal leishmaniasis, a core signature of IL32, LYZ, GBP1, IFI30, and FTH1 correlated with IDO1/CD274 expression. In Sri Lankan patients, high lesional IL-32+ cell density and high CD8+IL-32+ cell abundance predicted significantly slower cure rates following sodium stibogluconate treatment, whereas IL-32+FoxP3+ Tregs did not show a significant association. The study proposes that CCL18+ macrophages recruit IL-32+ CD8+ T cells and Tregs into a myeloid niche, where paracrine IL-32 signaling induces IDO1 and PD-L1, generating an immunosuppressive microenvironment that restrains immune-dependent chemotherapy.

Acting CDC Director Jim O’Neill called for splitting the MMR vaccine into three separate shots, a proposal not supported by medical research and lacking evidence of improved safety or effectiveness. The idea originated with Andrew Wakefield’s discredited autism link. Experts say monovalent vaccines are no longer available in the U.S., are logistically infeasible, and could leave children more vulnerable to infections. A 2017 study found that 69% of children completed the combined vaccine series compared to 50% for separate shots. Reintroducing monovalent vaccines would require years of clinical trials and FDA approval. The MMR vaccine has been used safely for over half a century, is highly effective, and carries minimal side effects. Physicians warn that such rhetoric could reduce vaccination rates, leading to more preventable disease and deaths.

Polaris is a version of Windows 10 built on Windows Core OS for desktop, laptop and 2-in-1 devices. It will rely entirely on UWP apps and feature CShell, a new interface replacing the legacy shell for a lighter, faster system. It will not support desktop applications natively or allow upgrades to Windows 10 Pro, though legacy apps may run via remote virtualization. It should be more secure, less resource intensive, with better battery life, and is expected in 2019.

The MSPM0C1105 and MSPM0C1106 are ultra-low-power 32-bit Arm Cortex-M0+ microcontrollers operating up to 32 MHz, featuring up to 64 KB of embedded flash and 8 KB of SRAM. They operate from 1.62 V to 3.6 V across a temperature range of −40°C to 125°C and integrate a high-speed on-chip oscillator, eliminating the need for an external crystal. The devices provide five main operating modes—RUN, SLEEP, STOP, STANDBY, and SHUTDOWN—managed across two power domains (PD1 and PD0) to balance performance and power consumption.

Key peripherals include a 12-bit 1.6-Msps ADC, a comparator with an 8-bit reference DAC, an on-chip temperature sensor, and a configurable 1.4 V or 2.5 V voltage reference. Digital peripherals include one 16-bit advanced timer supporting up to 64 MHz with deadband, four 16-bit general-purpose timers, a windowed watchdog timer, and an independent watchdog timer within the low-frequency subsystem. Communication interfaces consist of three UARTs, one SPI, and two I2Cs with protocol support for LIN, IrDA, DALI, SMBus, and PMBus. The devices also include a 3-channel DMA controller, a CRC-16 accelerator, and an event manager for routing peripheral events.

The clock module provides internal 32 kHz and 32 MHz oscillators and supports external low- and high-frequency crystal or digital clock inputs. The CPU subsystem includes pre-fetch logic, a two-line I-cache, a 24-bit SysTick timer, and a nested vectored interrupt controller with four programmable priority levels. Up to 45 GPIO pins are available with FastWake capability and flexible IOMUX configuration. Debug support is provided through a two-wire serial wire debug interface with an on-chip debug subsystem that includes a mailbox and security features such as SWD lockout. Flash memory supports up to 100,000 program/erase cycles on the first 32 KB. Recommended external circuitry includes 10 µF and 0.1 µF low-ESR ceramic decoupling capacitors on VDD and VSS, and a 47 kΩ pullup resistor with a 1000 pF pulldown capacitor on the NRST pin.

The "Drive & Kick" offense is a three-player weave from a 3-2 spread alignment using dribble penetration for layups. If denied, the handler passes outside and replaces the receiver, running time off the clock before a set play. Options include kick-out passes to corner players against zoning defenders and drop passes to back-cutting corner players when defenders sag.

This study explores empathy among 206 university teachers in Education faculties at University G, Spain, using the Interpersonal Reactivity Index (IRI). Overall empathy exceeded theoretical means, with high scores in Empathic Concern, Perspective Taking, and Fantasy, and moderate Personal Distress. Female participants scored significantly higher across all dimensions. No significant differences emerged based on contractual status, teaching experience, degree programme, or campus location. Teachers with prior non-university experience scored higher in Perspective Taking, Fantasy, and Empathic Concern, while those with only university experience showed higher Personal Distress. The authors conclude this pattern reflects a protective balance against emotional overinvolvement and highlight the need for empathetic teacher models to foster student empathy, while noting limitations in sample size and potential social desirability bias.

Intel released Coffee Lake desktop processors and Z370 chipsets; vendors launched motherboards. More Coffee Lake and H310/B360 chipsets launch Q1 2018, with notebook processors and vPro models through Q2; Gemini Lake Pentium/Celeron chips arrive November 2017. Cannon Lake 10nm CPUs debut mid-2018, Ice Lake in 2019; first 10nm products ship year-end 2017, ramping H1 2018.

Kent Howerton won the 1976 AMA 500cc National Motocross opener, with six different brands in the top six. In 1982, Ricky Johnson won the High Point 250 National, Honda went 1-2 in the 500cc class during Suzuki's last official year there, and top 125cc riders went to the Toronto Supercross. Yamaha riders planned to skip the Trans-USA Championship for lucrative international races, and Yamaha dropped riding coach Gary Bailey. Ross Pederson won the 1987 Montreal Supercross.

On August 13, 2017, three men from Illinois were shot and killed at point-blank range in the parking area of Great Lakes Dragaway near Union Grove, Wisconsin, during a drag racing event. Kenosha County Sheriff David Beth identified the victims as gang members and said the killings are suspected to be gang-related. The shooter, described as a black man aged 20 to 30 with a thin, athletic build, fled on foot and left in a vehicle; he remains at large. The pistol used was not recovered. Family members of the victims have been uncooperative with investigators. The event drew approximately 15,000 people and had private security but no weapons screening.

The 50 EMA strategy uses the 50-day Exponential Moving Average to identify medium-term trend direction and generate buy and sell signals, often confirmed with indicators such as RSI or MACD. Backtests show that a basic 50 EMA crossover system performs poorly across multiple assets, but results improve significantly when the 50 EMA is used as a filter combined with a second indicator, yielding strong risk-adjusted returns and lower maximum drawdowns on assets like QQQ and SPY compared to buy-and-hold. Traders typically apply the strategy on daily or 4-hour charts and should backtest to determine optimal settings and indicator combinations.

The AMD Secure RNG library provides APIs that abstract low-level x86 RDRAND and RDSEED instructions to access hardware-generated random numbers on AMD Zen processors. It offers functions to retrieve single 16-bit, 32-bit, or 64-bit values, arrays, or byte streams, while handling hardware failure checks and configurable retry attempts. The library includes CPUID-based APIs to verify hardware support for RDRAND and RDSEED. Use cases include cryptography, high-performance computing, and gaming. Because hardware access uses memory-mapped I/O and is slower than software pseudo-random number generators, latency-sensitive applications may use a hybrid approach where a software PRNG is seeded with hardware-generated values.

The Bearish Engulfing candlestick pattern signals a potential reversal from an uptrend to a downtrend, indicating that sellers have taken control. It is identified by a bullish candlestick followed by a larger bearish candlestick that completely engulfs the prior candle’s body, typically appearing after an upward trend.

Backtesting on the S&P 500 since 1993 indicates the pattern is the third most frequent of 75 candlestick patterns, with 311 instances, a win rate of 55% to 65%, and an average gain of 0.73% per trade when held for eight days. Adding technical filters, such as a 5-day RSI above 60, can improve average gains to 0.88%.

Traders use the pattern to identify entry and exit points, close long positions, enter short positions, and place stop-loss orders above the high of the white candlestick. Its reliability increases when confirmed by other indicators like RSI or MACD, momentum changes, or extended bullish context. Unlike the Bullish Engulfing pattern, which signals a downtrend-to-uptrend reversal, the Bearish Engulfing pattern reflects stronger bearish sentiment than similar patterns such as the dark cloud cover, evening star, and bearish harami.

Risks include false signals, market condition variability, and volatility. Traders should apply risk management through stop-loss orders, position sizing, diversification, and hedging. Disadvantages include subjectivity and unsuitability for all timeframes.

Liberal nonprofits are preparing for threats from the Trump administration following the murder of conservative activist Charlie Kirk, after which administration figures and allies blamed nonprofit organizations. President Trump designated “antifa” a terrorist organization and threatened to investigate its funders, while Justice Department members reportedly plan to investigate the Open Society Foundations. Republican legislators have introduced measures such as the Stop FUNDERs Act to strip nonprofit status from organizations accused of supporting violence. Foundations are accelerating funding disbursements to support grantees amid fears of defunding, reputational attacks, and self-censorship that could weaken civil society.

Stan Bowman and Coach Quenneville discussed their team's playoff readiness, praising Corey for his consistent progression and establishment as the number one goaltender.
