Early discipline is important as referees want to establish control, while special teams, particularly the powerplay, are vital in the playoffs. The team received contributions from all four lines, applied strong neutral zone pressure, and created traffic in front of the net. They overcame adversity through leadership and experience. Key moments included a big faceoff by Sakic, a goal by Ray, and pressure from Nieminen and Hinote driving to the net. Adam Foote is described as a marked man.

Blackwell GPUs add hardware encode and decode support for 4:2:2 chromasampled H.264 and HEVC video, balancing color fidelity and file size for professional workflows. The ninth-generation NVENC improves AV1 and HEVC quality by 5%, adds 4:2:2 encoding and an AV1 Ultra High Quality mode, while the RTX 5090 includes up to three encoders and two decoders for over 50% faster export speeds. The sixth-generation NVDEC doubles H.264 decode speed and adds 4:2:2 decode support. DisplayPort 2.1b enables up to 80 Gbps bandwidth, supporting 8K at 165 Hz and 4K at 480 Hz with DSC. Max-Q power efficiency features advanced power, clock, and rail gating, separate voltage rails for GPU cores and memory, accelerated frequency switching that is 1000x faster, and low-latency sleep states entered 10x faster than Ada, delivering up to 50% power savings in tasks like small language model inference. DLSS 4 introduces Multi Frame Generation, producing up to three additional frames per rendered frame with 40% faster AI models and 30% less VRAM, enhanced Flip Metering, and new transformer-based neural networks replacing CNNs for Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction, and DLAA, improving temporal stability, motion detail, and lighting quality. Blackwell also debuts neural shaders through the Cooperative Vectors API, enabling RTX Neural Materials, Neural Texture Compression, Neural Radiance Cache, RTX Skin, and RTX Neural Faces. The architecture comprises the flagship GB202 (RTX 5090) with 92.2 billion transistors and 24,576 CUDA cores; the high-end GB203 (RTX 5080/5070 Ti) with 45.6 billion transistors and 10,752 CUDA cores; and the performance GB205 (RTX 5070) with 31 billion transistors and 6,400 CUDA cores.

Strength training requires correct technique and proper warm-up and cool-down to prevent injuries such as rotator cuff injuries from repetitive overhead motions, hamstring strains or tears from sudden movements, herniated discs from poor weightlifting form, tendonitis from repetitive motions, and tennis or golfer's elbow from repetitive wrist and arm movements. Prevention includes maintaining good posture, stretching, limiting forceful repetitions, using appropriate weights, and increasing intensity gradually. Warming up increases heart rate and blood flow to prepare muscles, while cooling down regulates blood flow; dynamic movements are recommended for warm-ups and static exercises for cool-downs. Do not push through pain; rest and consult a doctor if pain persists, and seek guidance from qualified fitness instructors.

Authorities investigate a fire that destroyed South Carolina Judge Diane Goodstein's Edisto Island home and injured at least three family members. Goodstein was walking on the beach when the fire began Saturday; occupants jumped from an elevated floor and were rescued by kayak. Her husband, Arnold Goodstein, 81, was airlifted after ensuring others evacuated. Goodstein recently temporarily blocked the South Carolina Election Commission from providing voter registration information to the federal government.

Jonathan Toews, Patrick Kane, and Teuvo Teravainen discussed their team's play in the Stanley Cup Final. Toews said the team does not care where goals come from, emphasized playing smart, patient, two-way hockey, and noted both teams were testing each other early in the series. Kane praised a teammate called "Dunks" as a workhorse who plays in all situations. Toews praised Teuvo Teravainen's improvement and a teammate named Corey's ability to bounce back from losses. Kane and Toews highlighted the advantage of returning home to their own fans. Kane stated he will not force shots but will focus on making the right play. Teravainen said he does not care which opposing goaltender plays and expressed appreciation for learning from the group's experienced players.

This whitepaper details the NVIDIA Ampere GA10x GPU architecture, specifically the GA102 and GA104 GPUs fabricated on Samsung’s 8nm process. Building on the Turing architecture, GA10x delivers up to 1.7x faster traditional rasterization and up to 2x faster ray tracing. The Streaming Multiprocessor doubles peak FP32 throughput by enabling FP32 operations on both datapaths, and each SM contains 128 CUDA Cores, one second-generation RT Core, and four third-generation Tensor Cores. Second-generation RT Cores double the ray/triangle intersection testing rate and add an Interpolate Triangle Position unit for hardware-accelerated ray-traced motion blur, while also supporting concurrent ray tracing with graphics or compute workloads. Third-generation Tensor Cores support new data types including TF32 and BF16, and implement fine-grained structured sparsity to double effective throughput over Turing. The architecture introduces GDDR6X memory using PAM4 signaling for speeds up to 19.5 Gbps and bandwidth up to 936 GB/s, while professional cards use GDDR6. It also includes third-generation NVLink, a PCIe Gen 4 interface, and RTX IO technology for GPU-based asset loading and decompression. GA102 powers the GeForce RTX 3090, RTX 3080, NVIDIA RTX A6000, and NVIDIA A40; GA104 powers the GeForce RTX 3070. The platform supports 8K gaming and display output via HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4a with DSC, and includes fifth-generation NVDEC with AV1 hardware decode and seventh-generation NVENC. Other architectural changes include integrating ROPs into Graphics Processing Clusters, increasing L1 cache and shared memory capacity, and adding Error Detection and Replay (EDR) technology to the GDDR6X memory interface for improved overclocking stability.

Google introduced UI changes in Chrome Canary for Windows via the "Refreshed" UI Layout flag in chrome://flags. Changes include rectangular tabs with rounded upper corners replacing trapezoids, a brighter white active tab, and a rounded address bar. Other additions include a separator after add-on icons and a user account image. Internal documents revealed a shift of the new-tab button to the left of the address bar. The stable build release date is unclear.

The authors extend their ab initio approach for computing spin diffusion length (ls) and spin lifetime (τs) to incorporate electric fields (E) along periodic directions, addressing a critical gap for simulating spin-drift effects in spintronic devices. Existing drift-diffusion models can yield significant errors in systems such as graphene-h-BN and wurtzite GaN due to spatial spin precession. Using a covariant derivative formalism within a linearized steady-state quantum master equation, they derive the transport equation under finite E and compute ls(E) by solving related eigenvalue problems. They also propose a new Rayleigh–Ritz model formula for ls(E) applicable to both semiconductors and metals beyond the effective mass approximation. Theoretical results are presented for monolayer WSe2, bulk GaAs, bulk GaN, and graphene-h-BN. The drift operator is computed via a Wannier-representation finite-difference technique that avoids complications from arbitrary phase factors and band degeneracies in direct k-space derivatives.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K with the SEC on June 4, 2018, announcing a definitive agreement to acquire GitHub for $7.5 billion. The filing includes a press release dated June 4, 2018 (Exhibit 99.1) and an investor presentation (Exhibit 99.2), and was signed by Carolyn Frantz, Secretary.

Former Middlebury student Addis Fouche-Channer ’17 was falsely accused by a Public Safety officer of participating in the March protest of Charles Murray’s lecture. The officer claimed he pulled her from a vehicle but provided no other evidence. After declining police and investigator interviews, she was charged in May with violating the college’s protest policy. She contested the charge and submitted alibi evidence including Wi-Fi logs, witness statements, and timestamped coursework. The judicial dean dismissed the case on May 13 after IT logs confirmed she was not present. Following graduation, Fouche-Channer sought an apology, prompting a college investigation into whether the officer racially profiled her. The human relations officer continued to demand evidence of her whereabouts even after the judicial dismissal. As of mid-September, the college had not yet issued a decision on the racial profiling complaint.

America’s science education crisis is marked by declining proficiency and student interest, even as STEM jobs grow. Although 49 states have adopted inquiry-based science standards, many classrooms still prioritize memorization. The passage advocates for a “science of science education” strategy emphasizing high-quality instructional materials and curriculum-based professional learning. Students learn best by designing investigations and solving relevant problems, yet few validated middle and high school programs exist. Districts should adopt quality materials—including open educational resources—and invest in sustained professional learning that engages teachers as learners first, shifting instruction from content delivery to guiding student sense-making. School leaders must provide planning time, signal science education’s importance, and prioritize ongoing implementation support over generic workshops and immediate test results.

On May 25, 2016, Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K announcing plans to streamline its smartphone hardware business. The plan includes reducing up to 1,850 positions, with 1,350 at Microsoft Mobile Oy in Finland. Microsoft will record an impairment and restructuring charge of approximately $950 million in the quarter ending June 30, 2016, including about $200 million in severance. The actions are expected to be substantially complete by the end of the calendar year and fully completed by July 2017.

The Canadian Social Determinants Urban Laboratory (CSDUL) is a multilevel, longitudinal virtual data environment developed by the Urban Public Health Network Research Group and the University of Saskatchewan to analyze how social determinants of health affect income-related health inequalities in urban Canada. Operationalizing the WHO Social Determinants of Health framework, CSDUL links over 15 survey and administrative databases—including the Canadian Population Health Survey, Canadian Community Health Survey, health administrative records, Canada Revenue Agency tax files, and area-level environmental and socioeconomic indicators—within Statistics Canada’s secure Research Data Centres. Organized around a central hub and five nodes (Political and Economic Context, Environmental Context, Socioeconomic Context, Material Circumstances, and Health Systems), the project will create validated area-based indicators at macro, meso, and micro levels. Using pooled multilevel logistic regression and twofold Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition analysis, the study will replicate WHO/Europe’s income-related health inequality methodology to estimate the relative contributions of structural and individual-level determinants to self-reported health disparities across income quintiles in Canadian cities and towns. Initially spanning 2011–2017, CSDUL aims to provide reusable data components, methods, and evidence to support multisectoral, population-specific health equity interventions.

This paper investigates the feasibility of Vehicular Cloud Computing (VCC) in 5G-enabled urban environments, addressing performance, sustainability, and economic incentives. It proposes a centralized 5G architecture comprising end-users, a gNodeB, a Network Operator-owned controller, compute-capable vehicles, and a cloud backup. The controller collects periodic vehicle beacons and assigns tasks to ranked executors based on dwell time, energy availability, and computational capacity. The authors develop an integrated simulation framework combining urban vehicular mobility traces, 5G communication, task characteristics, and energy models to design a utility-driven, lightweight allocation strategy that respects deadlines and energy constraints. They model revenue sharing among the Network Operator, vehicle owners, and cloud provider as a stochastic coalitional game, proving its robust core is non-empty to guarantee stable, fair allocations under uncertainty. The paper also quantifies CO2 savings compared to traditional edge infrastructures and analyzes long-term incentives for vehicle participation. The system model formalizes offloading time, energy consumption, and costs as random variables influenced by mobility and network conditions. Task allocation is formulated as a utility-maximization problem based on nominal parameter values, subject to one-executor-per-task and capacity constraints, while revenue sharing uses realized post-execution values.
Tesla, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on November 7, 2018, reporting it published a blog post on its website that day as Exhibit 99.1. Todd A. Maron, General Counsel, signed the report.

Chamomile is an ancient herbal remedy; Matricaria recutita (German) and Chamaemelum nobile (Roman) are widely grown. Matricaria recutita, historically used in teas, is recognized in pharmacopoeias for anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and spasmolytic properties. Its primary extract, chamomile oil, is obtained via steam distillation of flowers with yields of 0.2–0.4%. The oil contains medicinal compounds including coumarins, sesquiterpenes, and flavonoids. Used orally or topically for insomnia, anxiety, muscle pain, digestive issues, conjunctivitis, and skin conditions, it is also an ingredient in commercial products such as cosmetics, food, and detergents.

GMR Infrastructure posted consolidated net loss of Rs565.94 crore for December 2017 quarter, versus profit of Rs643.44 crore year earlier, as income and expenses fell. It operates airports and develops smart cities adjacent to Delhi and Hyderabad.

In Bottoms v. The State, the appellant pled guilty to theft by receiving and financial transaction card theft. The trial court ordered restitution for all items stolen in the burglaries. The appellate court found no abuse of discretion in granting a continuance for the restitution hearing, but reversed the restitution order, holding it must be limited to damages from the acts for which she was sentenced, not the uncharged burglaries. The case was remanded for resentencing, and the remaining enumeration was moot.

Exxon Mobil reported fourth-quarter earnings of 88 cents per share, missing the $1.04 estimate and sending shares down 3%. Full-year earnings were $19.7 billion on $244.36 billion in revenue, including a $5.9 billion gain from U.S. tax cuts. The company plans $50 billion in U.S. investment over five years and kept its 77-cent dividend. 2017 crude income rose $9 billion despite lower production, and Exxon aims to triple Permian Basin output. With oil above $65 and Goldman Sachs forecasting over $82 by summer, upstream focus and downstream earnings could drive 2018 growth.

Diplomatic cables from January–February 1917 report on the war and U.S. peace efforts. Ambassador Page noted Italy’s defense of fixed coal prices and Vatican criticism of alleged Allied plans to expand Russian influence in Europe. The Minister in Greece reported satisfactory settlement progress, while the Minister in the Netherlands forwarded Dutch parliamentary questions regarding President Wilson’s December 18 peace note. In a January 22 Senate address, Wilson stated that the Central Powers had offered to discuss peace terms in conference, while the Entente had submitted more definite conditions, bringing the nations closer to negotiating a durable peace and an international concert to prevent future conflicts.

A meta-analysis of 333,247 adults found moderate drinkers—men consuming up to 14 weekly alcohol servings, women up to seven—had lower all-cause mortality than abstainers or heavy drinkers over around eight years, and were roughly a quarter less likely to die of heart disease or stroke. Heavy drinkers had roughly 45% higher cancer death odds than moderate drinkers, and weekly binge drinking raised death odds by about 16%. Benefits were strongest for adults 60 and older, non-Latino whites, and women; no benefit was seen in adults 18 to 39 or non-Latino blacks. The World Health Organization recommends abstaining from alcohol, citing 3.3 million deaths in 2012, though moderate intake may benefit cardiovascular health.

IWM is the ticker for the iShares Russell 2000 ETF, tracking the index of the 2,000 smallest U.S. companies, a benchmark for small-cap stocks and U.S. economic bellwether. The index rebalances annually in June, changing components. The Russell 2000 Rebalancing Trading Strategy is tied to this period with solid performance; positions can be hedged against the S&P 500. IWM correlates with the broader market but can deviate significantly, aiding diversification.

Marcus Lemonis, CEO of Good Sam Club and Camping World, purchased bankrupt Gander Mountain, now Gander Outdoors, reopening 69 stores. After buying Good Sam Club, he called members "marketing tools," cancelled rallies, and repurposed the Good Sam Man mascot for Gander Outdoors.

Apple has reportedly shelved plans for a cheaper, lighter Vision Pro to focus on lightweight AI smart glasses similar to Meta's Ray-Bans. The $3,500 Vision Pro, launched in February 2024, has struggled due to its high price, bulk, and unclear purpose, with Apple executives privately viewing it as overengineered. While Meta's $800-plus Ray-Ban Display glasses may attract more buyers, and Google has similar plans, face-worn computers have yet to achieve mainstream consumer adoption despite years of investment, making it too early to declare a market winner.

The speaker states that winning the Stanley Cup is their biggest career accomplishment but emphasizes the need to continuously prove themselves. They recall being happy playing in Finland before deciding to return, staying level-headed after a game-winning goal, experiencing panic and nerves during the finals while faking confidence, and feeling honored to win the Conn Smythe alongside other goaltender names on the trophy.

Taylor Swift is credited as the sole writer on 67 songs across her career, having composed the lyrics and melodies alone. She began writing at age 10 and was the youngest songwriter signed at 15. While she is the lead writer on every released song and has collaborated with producers such as Max Martin and Shellback, the article lists more than 60 tracks she wrote solely by herself in loose chronological order. The list spans from her earliest releases through her 2024 album "The Tortured Poets Department: The Anthology," including "Our Song," "Love Story," "Dear John," "Red," and "The Black Dog."

Joe Hadzima introduces the MIT course "Nuts and Bolts of New Ventures and Business Plans," explaining that it treats planning as a dynamic process for launching ventures rather than producing a fixed document, applicable to businesses, nonprofits, and governmental ventures. He recounts the course's 25-year origin, when students sought practical startup guidance, leading to an entrepreneurial model of identifying customers, defining tasks, recruiting experts, and delegating execution. He observes that economic downturns often foster enduring companies by forcing focus on genuine value creation.

The fundamental framework for any venture is to create value and then capture enough of it to sustain operations. The course uses the Virtual Ink case study to examine real-world execution. Hadzima presents a communication pyramid—mission statement, elevator pitch, executive summary, presentation, and full plan—supported by detailed foundations. He argues that an entrepreneur's scarcest resource is time, making planning essential to evaluate whether an idea justifies long-term commitment. A plan is a selling document to attract financing, partners, and talent, but the team must own and defend it.

An executive summary should answer "Why this?", "Why now?", and "Why this team?" while addressing potential skepticism. The plan's body must define the opportunity, market dynamics, development steps, and "credibility testers" to de-risk the project. Hadzima warns against projects requiring everything to work at once, dependencies on large organizations, and common failures such as insignificant markets, non-credible technology, misunderstanding the market, or sloppy presentation. He describes the process as iterative, aiming to distill a clear, supported vision.

Texas public universities including San Jacinto College, Texas Tech’s Angelo State, and Texas A&M have directed faculty to review syllabi and course content to ensure compliance with federal and state laws and executive orders. Faculty at San Jacinto and Angelo State received verbal instructions to remove content regarding transgender identity, preferred names, pronouns, and pride flags; Texas Tech’s chancellor later prohibited employees from teaching about or acknowledging transgender identity. Written directives often lacked specifics, citing only vague legal compliance risks. A senior attorney at FIRE stated no federal or state laws prohibit teaching about transgender identity, calling the directives an unsupported, voluntary effort to censor faculty speech that contradicts the First Amendment. Faculty have reported confusion and fear, and the Texas AAUP is encouraging censorship reports to FIRE.

The lecture reviews countable-state Markov processes, defined by an embedded Markov chain and state-dependent exponential leaving rates nu_i. Steady-state probabilities p_j satisfy p_j = (pi_j / nu_j) / sum_k (pi_k / nu_k), where pi_j are the embedded chain steady-state probabilities. If sum_k (pi_k / nu_k) is infinite, the transition rate goes to zero and the process lacks a meaningful steady state. For birth/death processes, the overall rate moving up equals the rate moving down. An irreducible process solving the rate-in-equals-rate-out equations yields a positive recurrent embedded chain. Reversibility requires backward and forward transition rates to be equal; if an irreducible process satisfies p_i q_ij = p_j q_ji for all i,j and the probabilities sum to one, then the process is reversible, positive recurrent, and the p_j represent sample-path time fractions. All birth/death processes with finite transition conditions are reversible. Burke’s theorem for an M/M/1 queue with arrival rate lambda less than service rate mu states that the departure process is Poisson with rate lambda, the state is independent of past departures, and under first-come-first-served service a customer’s arrival time given its departure is independent of earlier departures. Tandem M/M/1 queues preserve the Poisson departure property for the second queue, and the two systems’ states are independent. The lecture then covers random walks—sums of i.i.d. random variables—including simple random walks, integer random walks, and renewal processes as non-negative special cases. It discusses threshold crossing problems and the G/G/1 queue waiting time equation W_n = max(W_{n-1} + U_n, 0), where U_n is the previous service time minus the current inter-arrival time, forming a random walk reflected at zero. The lecture concludes by introducing binary hypothesis testing with i.i.d. observations conditional on the hypothesis, using Bayes’ law to compare posterior probabilities, and previews that random walks will appear in the next lecture.

The passage documents classified U.S.-Soviet relations memoranda and meetings from February 4 to March 16, 1983. President Reagan initialed several memos and met with Secretary of State Shultz and Soviet Ambassador Dobrynin on February 15, directing Shultz to serve as a direct channel to Andropov. National Security Advisor Clark expressed skepticism about Soviet intentions regarding Pentecostalists. Various officials drafted, cleared, and forwarded secret and sensitive correspondence between Washington and San Francisco.

macOS screenshots include drop shadows. To disable them in macOS High Sierra, enter `defaults write com.apple.screencapture disable-shadow true` in Terminal, then `killall SystemUIServer`. Restart if needed. To re-enable, use "false" instead of "true".

Resilient centermen can replace Doug Weight if he does not play. They must attack the net and pressure the goaltender, who frequently leaves it. The team has refocused on Saturday to close out the series after a tough loss and has extra rest. They must be physical and play better as a team to win.

A government scheme launched in 2011 and merged with RKSK in 2014 to promote sanitary napkins among rural girls aged 10–19 increased usage from 50.7% to 54% between 2014 and 2015. The scheme faces problems including poor quality, irregular supply and stockouts, lack of awareness, inadequate ASHA training, and unsafe disposal of non-biodegradable napkins. Fund utilization was low nationally but higher in focus states. Traditional menstrual practices persist due to taboos, contributing to infections. Some states reported satisfactory uptake, while others saw declines or low adoption due to mediocre quality and supply delays of up to three months.

The passage details UHS-II interface selection, initialization, and SD memory card operational protocols per the Physical Layer Simplified Specification Version 6.00. UHS-II hosts and cards support both Legacy SD Bus and UHS-II interfaces; after power-up, the host attempts UHS-II initialization by detecting STB.L on the D1 lane within a 200µs timeout, otherwise falling back to SD Bus mode. UHS-II initialization proceeds through PHY synchronization, device initialization, enumeration assigning a unique Device ID, configuration, and SD-TRAN initialization. The specification introduces UHS-III (FD624) and defines bus speed modes, power limits (default 0.72W, up to 1.80W for removable cards), and card types (SDSC, SDHC, SDXC).

Card operation involves two modes: Card Identification Mode and Data Transfer Mode. After reset or power-on, cards are in Idle State. The host issues CMD0, then CMD8 (mandatory for SDHC/SDXC) to verify operating voltage, followed by ACMD41 to initialize and identify cards, set the Host Capacity Support (HCS) bit, and determine Card Capacity Status (CCS). Cards publish their Relative Card Address (RCA) via CMD3 to enter Stand-by State. In UHS-I, the host uses ACMD41 with S18R to request 1.8V signaling and CMD11 to execute the voltage switch; CMD19 tunes the sampling point if needed.

In Data Transfer Mode, the host uses addressed commands. CMD7 selects a card for transfer. Data reads use CMD17/CMD18 and writes use CMD24/CMD25, abortable by CMD12. ACMD23 pre-erases blocks for faster multi-block writes. Erase, Discard, and Full User Area Logical Erase (FULE) operations use CMD32, CMD33, and CMD38 with specific arguments; Discard and FULE are supported only on SDHC/SDXC.

The specification defines lock/unlock functions via CMD42, including password protection (PWD) and Card Ownership Protection (COP) with Force Erase Password (FEP). COP Cards require a COP Unlock command (CMD42[1Fh]) to access extended functions when FEP is set. Force Erase clears all data and passwords unless blocked by FEP.

CMD6 switches card functions across four groups: Access Mode (bus speed), Command System, Driver Strength, and Power Limit. Mode 0 queries supported functions; Mode 1 sets them. Power Limit settings affect maximum current consumption and must accommodate host supply capability. Application-specific commands require CMD55 (APP_CMD) preceding them.

Jamie advocates treating the brain as a muscle requiring regular exercise and daily attention, arguing that managing the mind is a learnable skill. The goal is not pursuing transient happiness or perfection, but accepting that all emotions are temporary and life involves natural ebbs and flows. She proposes a seven-step daily process to reduce emotional impact and gain perspective: (1) check in and label your current emotion; (2) practice slow five-count belly breathing for at least 30 seconds; (3) write down thoughts and feelings, then rip up the paper; (4) list things you are grateful for; (5) play a mindful mini-game such as drawing or puzzles; (6) complete a compassion challenge like forgiving someone or giving yourself a compliment; and (7) send a positive message to someone else. Studies cited indicate that accepting feelings reduces their emotional impact and that focusing on others increases happiness.

The author questions accusations that the Government doctored an electoral reform Bill, arguing they stem from misinformation. The passage explains that Bills are draft laws typically initiated by government departments and approved by Cabinet, while Law Commission recommendations pass through the Executive to be framed into Bills. Since the Executive is responsible for shaping Bills before they reach Parliament, the author contends accusations of doctoring are misplaced. Parliament ultimately debates and shapes Bills, and citizens should remain quiet and attentive until the Bill reaches the House.

Charles Robert Jenkins, a U.S. soldier who deserted to North Korea in 1965 to avoid combat duty, died in Japan at age 77. In North Korea, he taught English, acted in propaganda films, and married Hitomi Soga, a kidnapped Japanese woman. Soga returned to Japan in 2002; Jenkins and their daughters followed in 2004 after a 30-day desertion sentence. He lived in Sado, worked in a gift shop, and wrote a book about his experiences.

This work establishes a theoretical framework for the emergent linearity of macroscopic dynamics under spatial averaging in large-scale populations of heterogeneous, interconnected, nonlinear stochastic systems. Motivated by empirical findings that linear models effectively capture macroscopic brain and artificial neural network dynamics despite microscopic nonlinearity, the contributions include: extending mixing process theory via a multivariate central limit theorem for ρ-mixing sequences, a notion of residual factors, and extensions to spatially-embedded ρ*-mixing sequences; proving asymptotic linearity of averaged state dynamics, which are generally linear time-varying; showing they become linear time-invariant under additional stationarity; and characterizing finite-sample convergence rates, which are parametric for independent subsystems and degrade with stronger correlations. The preliminaries review ρ-mixing sequences, slowly-varying functions, and a central limit theorem for such sequences. The problem considers N discrete-time nonlinear subsystems with finite spatial neighborhoods and defines an averaged, mean-subtracted state vector. Residual factors are shown to exist for multivariate ρ-mixing sequences with uniformly bounded variance, and explicit forms are derived for specific correlation decay rates: h(N)=log(N) for ϱ(n)=1/n, h(N)=N/log(N) for ϱ(n)=1/log(1+n), and h(N)=N^{1−p} for ϱ(n)=1/n^p where p∈(0,1).

Experts from Hinge Health, Fidelity, and AuditBoard discussed IPO strategies at a September 30 Business Insider event sponsored by Fidelity Investments. They noted that companies face shifting investor expectations, regulatory demands, and cultural challenges when going public, but staying private longer allows more time to prepare. Panelists advised bringing in dedicated experts to manage the 18- to 24-month transition, ensuring operational and strategic readiness, and selecting the right investors, brokers, and compensation tools to retain talent. They also emphasized transparently communicating quarterly results to employees and providing financial planning support, as IPOs create significant wealth opportunities for staff.

On July 30, 2020, Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K announcing its second quarter 2020 financial results, incorporating by reference a press release as Exhibit 99.1 and information regarding non-GAAP financial measures as Exhibit 99.2. The report was signed by Brian T. Olsavsky, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.

The lecture reviews the path-integral master formula for time-ordered correlation functions and applies it to interacting theories by splitting the action into a free part S0 and a small interaction part Si. The interacting n-point function Gn is expanded perturbatively in Si, yielding a ratio of free-theory expectation values of time-ordered products; this is equation (star) and corresponds to Peskin & Schroeder 4.31. Free-theory correlators are evaluated using Wick’s theorem, reducing them to products of free Feynman propagators GF0.

For φ⁴ theory with interaction Lagrangian Li = −λ/4! φ⁴, the two-point function is computed to first order in λ. The combinatorics of field contractions are represented diagrammatically: a line stands for GF0(x−y) and a vertex for the interaction. The 1/n! from expanding the exponential and the 1/4! per vertex cancel against permutations of vertices and legs, leaving only diagram-specific symmetry factors.

Feynman rules are given in coordinate space (external points carry a factor 1, propagators give GF0, vertices give −iλ with spacetime integration, divide by symmetry factors) and in momentum space (external lines carry momenta, propagators are −i/(k²+m²−iε), vertices give iλ, momentum is conserved at each vertex, integrate over undetermined momenta). A second-order λ² diagram is converted to its momentum-space expression as an example.

The Netflix documentary “Unknown Number: The High School Catfish” follows Beal City, Michigan, junior high student Lauryn Licari and her boyfriend Owen McKenny as they receive escalating hateful, sexually graphic, and threatening text messages from an unknown number that uses personal details about their lives. After 18 months of inconclusive local investigation, the FBI became involved and requested a forensic examination of Owen’s phone. The author, Oklahoma City criminal defense attorney Adam R. Banner, criticizes the documentary for not thoroughly exploring cellphone forensics and the scope of digital investigations. He connects the case to broader concerns about teen cellphone dangers and notes that Oklahoma passed a “bell to bell” no-cellphone policy for the 2025–2026 school year.

Apple Inc.'s June 7, 2016 Form 8-K reports the June 22, 2016 issuance and sale of $1,377,000,000 in 4.15% senior unsecured notes due 2046, under a June 7, 2016 subscription agreement with Deutsche Bank AG, Taipei Branch and KGI Securities Co. Ltd. and an April 29, 2013 indenture with The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A. Interest is payable semi-annually on June 22 and December 22. Related exhibits are filed.

This paper investigates methods to ensure 100% valid molecule generation by Large Language Models (LLMs). While SELFIES guarantees molecular validity, experiments show LLMs perform worse using it compared to SMILES due to its lower prevalence in pretraining corpora and inherent representation characteristics; the proposed Invalid SELFIES Editing ensures validity but degrades performance on other metrics. Using LLMs as iterative post-hoc correctors for invalid SMILES improves validity but significantly reduces other metrics, with correction rates varying by model and error type. To address these limitations, the authors propose SmiSelf, a cross-chemical language framework that converts invalid SMILES into SELFIES via molecular graphs and transforms them back into valid SMILES, leveraging SELFIES' robustness to correct syntactic and semantic errors. Experiments on the ChEBI-20 dataset demonstrate that SmiSelf achieves 100% validity, preserves molecular characteristics, and maintains or enhances performance on other metrics for both text-based and class-specific molecule generation tasks, with smaller performance trade-offs than constrained decoding or LLM-based correction methods.

This study reports field-free superconducting diode effect (SDE) in NbSe₂ induced by local uniaxial strain, applied by placing thin flakes on curved aluminum nanoridge substrates. Electrical transport experiments reveal significant SDE exclusively in stressed regions, with a zero-field critical current difference (ΔIc) of 286 μA and a superconducting diode efficiency (η) of 6.76%, while no SDE appears in unstressed regions. Under external magnetic fields, different strained devices exhibit distinct symmetries: ΔIc follows either symmetric (B-even), antisymmetric (B-odd), or mixed behavior with respect to the magnetic field. The authors attribute this anisotropy to two independent, spatially orthogonal non-reciprocal mechanisms: a stress-activated real-space polarization along the armchair direction produces B-even SDE, whereas a magnetic-field-activated valley-polarization mechanism along the zigzag direction produces B-odd SDE. The work provides an experimental platform for generating zero-field SDEs and offers potential applications for superconducting quantum devices.

Fitch Ratings affirmed Marsh & McLennan Companies, Inc.'s Long-Term IDR and senior unsecured debt ratings at 'A-' and short-term ratings at 'F2', revising the Rating Outlook to Positive from Stable. The revision reflects MMC's sustained improved operating performance, stronger credit metrics, strong balance sheet, and excellent cash flow generation relative to peers. MMC holds a top-tier competitive position in insurance brokerage and consulting, with manageable contingent risks. At Dec. 31, 2016, the company reported $1 billion in cash, EBITDA-to-interest coverage above 16x, and debt-to-EBITDA at 1.5x. The 2016 operating EBIT margin was 20%, up from 19%, with organic revenue growth in both the Risk & Insurance Services and Consulting segments. Fitch expects continued free cash flow growth and strong metrics. Upgrade triggers include sustained EBIT margins of 18% or better, debt-to-EBITDA near 1.5x, and EBITDA-to-interest expense exceeding 14x. Fitch affirmed all listed senior debt ratings at 'A-'.

SOS disruptive pressure defense directs ball handlers to sideline, corner, or baseline checkpoints using SET, ON, and SMOTHER techniques. Defenders assume SNUGGLE pass denial and post FRONTS, apply Box Pressure on the wing, and use contact traps on screens, penetrations, mismatches, and corner situations. Weakside defenders establish Helpside I alignments—Double, Triple, or Triangle—to provide backside help, deny weakside cuts, and rotate to trap or close out to the nearest player on passes out of traps. On the wing, defenders push the ball baseline, turn middle drives back to the sideline, and execute Cross Switches at the free throw line. All five defenders must box out and flood the boards on shot attempts.

OpenAI and Stripe codeveloped the open-source Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP), enabling Instant Checkout within ChatGPT. Built atop Anthropic’s MCP standard, it integrates Stripe’s payments and fraud prevention, launching with U.S. sellers including Etsy and Shopify before expanding to over a million Stripe merchants such as Glossier, Skims, Spanx, and Vuori. Because ACP is open source, other AI assistants could adopt it, potentially challenging Google and Amazon as default shopping destinations. ChatGPT product lead Michelle Fradin said the merchant-first approach reduces integration friction. Merchants must provide structured product data to be recommended, giving rise to a new discipline some call AIO as a successor to SEO. While brands may cede direct customer relationships and pay Stripe transaction fees, the frictionless reach may outweigh drawbacks. The shift positions ChatGPT as a recommendation arbiter, raising questions about selection criteria and future paid placement, though Fradin noted recommendations currently rely on AI access to quality product information rather than a fixed formula.

Scientists studying brown recluse spiders discovered they create industrial-strength silk using spinnerets to sew micro-loops with a clamp-and-release motion. The spider's silk is uniquely thin, flat, and sticky, resembling nano-scale tape. These loops significantly enhance the material's toughness and flexibility. Researchers have developed mathematical models and filed a patent for synthetic versions, though none has been created yet. Potential applications include protective webs for space structures, improved parachute cords, lightweight bungee cords, and stunt equipment. The material could improve any fabric requiring strength, flexibility, and lightness, offering a potential green alternative to petroleum-based materials.

The Beerepoot family, owners of the Melita Honey Farm, face auction of their home on September 1 for unpaid council rates since 2010, believing God owns the land. Meander Valley Council will sell the property to recover $9332. Rates on two other properties were paid in June. Mayor Craig Perkins said the owners have not contacted the council. Proceeds, minus unpaid rates, will go to the family.

Engravings at three rock outcrops in Arabia’s Nefud Desert date to between 12,800 and 11,400 years ago, when the region was lush and wet. The 150 newly documented petroglyphs, including life-size camels, were created by early nomadic peoples in four phases: stylized women, larger human figures, naturalistic animals, and later cartoonish animals. Researchers suggest the monumental art, visible for miles, may have marked territory or indicated water sources. Stone tools found nearby reveal links to prehistoric peoples in the Eastern Mediterranean, yet the scale and style represent a distinct new tradition illustrating human occupation and adaptation during the Pleistocene-Holocene transition.

University of Washington astronomer Rory Barnes found that many potentially habitable exoplanets discovered by upcoming telescopes will likely be tidally locked, with one side permanently facing their host star. By challenging assumptions that only smaller, dimmer stars host such planets and exploring wider initial rotation periods and orbital parameters, he determined tidal locking is a major factor in exoplanet evolution. Though once thought to preclude life, tidal locking may allow moderate climates if atmospheres are present. Barnes noted NASA's TESS satellite will likely detect only tidally locked habitable planets, and knowing a planet's tidal locking status is crucial for the search for life.

A prospective, multicenter, double-blind, randomized phase 3 trial in India evaluated CORBEVAX™, a recombinant protein subunit vaccine, as a heterologous booster in 416 adults aged 18–80 who had previously received two doses of COVAXIN or COVISHIELD. Subjects were randomized 3:1 to receive a single booster dose of CORBEVAX™ or placebo. The vaccine was safe and well tolerated; all adverse events were mild to moderate, with no serious adverse events, grade 3 events, or deaths reported. By day 28, CORBEVAX™ elicited statistically superior humoral and cellular immune responses compared with placebo in both primed groups, including significant increases in neutralizing antibodies against the ancestral SARS-CoV-2 strain and the Omicron variant. Omicron-specific responder rates increased from 43% to 91% among COVISHIELD™ recipients and from 33% to 75% among COVAXIN recipients. Th1 cellular responses were enhanced, while Th2 responses were comparable. The study currently reports 28-day data, with longer-term follow-up ongoing.

According to an IDC survey of 200 industrial enterprises in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland, simulation, modeling, and data analytics are increasingly used to drive innovation, accelerate product development, improve quality, and reduce costs. Deployment in product development, production planning, and quality management is expected to rise to 90% within two years, though data silos remain a barrier, necessitating integrated data strategies and a unified information base. Technologies such as digital twins, virtual prototyping, and IoT feedback loops are advancing development processes. High-Performance Computing (HPC) is seen as a game changer by 81% of respondents for enabling complex calculations and new business models. While over a quarter already use professional HPC and 39% are planning adoption, most prefer external, cloud-based, or colocation infrastructures over on-premises solutions due to flexibility and cost. Security, energy consumption, and lack of expertise are key challenges. IDC recommends virtual development environments, holistic data integration, scalable HPC solutions—frequently via HPC as a Service—and leveraging external partners to support digital transformation.

The 2016 Hero Indian Super League season finale in Kochi had 54,000 attendees and 41 million TV viewers. Total viewership rose 41 percent to 216 million, with rural India contributing 101 million. It was Kerala's most viewed sporting event, surpassing the T20 World Cup semi-final, Euro 2016 final, and FIFA World Cup 2014 final, while West Bengal viewership exceeded the IPL 9 finals. Mumbai and Chennai grew over 50 percent, and Tamil Nadu rose 20 percent. Stadium attendance averaged 84 percent capacity. Digital watch time increased 2.3 times, while overall engagement rose over 25 percent.

Pan Finance reports global financial intelligence including Fifth Third’s $10.9B Comerica acquisition, Santander UK CEO departure before the TSB merger, JPMorgan Chase accelerating AI integration, the BoE’s largest six-month repo since 2020, AMD stock surging on an OpenAI chip deal, London IPO revival hopes, Tesla’s record Q3 deliveries and affordable EV speculation, a Trump team equity tool proposal, U.S. stocks climbing amid shutdown threats, the Bifrost subsea cable launch, Poland’s $5.5B NATO fuel network investment, $18B in frozen NYC infrastructure funds, Danantara’s Indonesia waste-to-power projects, South Korea restoring services after a data centre fire, Bezos’s space-based data centre plans, OpenAI’s $500B valuation and parental controls launch, Opera’s Neon AI browser, and awards for FEAMICOL, SocialTrading.AI, CGW, and the LuSE. China halted U.S. soybean purchases, hitting American farmers.

This study examines how Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine affected foreign co-funding, authorship patterns, and citation impact of Scopus-indexed articles funded by Ukraine’s Ministry of Education and Science (MESU), National Academy of Sciences (NASU), and National Research Foundation (NRFU) between 2020 and 2023. Amid wartime budget cuts, declining research output, and scholar displacement, the proportion of Ukrainian articles acknowledging funding rose from 21.7% to 28.5%, with the three agencies’ combined share increasing from 8.6% to 11.9%. Foreign co-funding remained significant, particularly for NASU, while Russia disappeared from top collaborator lists and Poland, Germany, the USA, and the EU became dominant partners. The share of articles with foreign co-affiliations grew in 2022–2023, driven by researcher displacement, though international co-authorship rates slightly declined for NASU and NRFU. Citation impact, measured by field-normalised citation impact (FNCI), was consistently highest for foreign-only funded articles and lowest for NASU-only funded articles; MESU-funded articles saw notable impact growth in 2022–2023 driven by highly cited outliers among scholars with foreign co-affiliations. Statistical models confirmed foreign co-funding’s positive association with impact for NASU and NRFU, while NASU-only funded articles in 2022–2023 performed no better than unfunded articles, raising concerns about domestic funding efficiency. The findings underscore that international collaboration and foreign co-funding enhance research visibility more than domestic funding alone and recommend prioritising joint international funding and establishing a centralised national funding database to improve transparency and allocation.

Mike Peca has won the Selke Trophy and been nominated again. The North Stars and Dallas Stars have aimed for the Stanley Cup for nine years and now participate in the finals. Unrestricted free agency has existed for only four or five years; after early unsuccessful attempts, the team has used it successfully to add players.

The lecture reviews that extending the black hole metric to Euclidean signature requires periodic identification of time $\tau$, implying that quantum field theory in that spacetime must be at a finite temperature determined by the surface gravity $\kappa$. A parallel periodicity condition in Rindler spacetime implies a finite temperature for local observers there.

The vacuum state obtained via this analytic continuation is observer-dependent. For a black hole, this yields the Hartle-Hawking vacuum, which is regular at the horizon. Straightforward canonical quantization using Schwarzschild time instead yields the Schwarzschild (or Boulware) vacuum; because its Euclidean manifold is singular at the horizon and physical observables blow up there, the Hartle-Hawking vacuum is considered more physical under the assumption that the horizon is smooth.

For Rindler spacetime, periodically identifying the Euclidean time $\theta$ with period $2\pi$ corresponds to choosing the standard Minkowski vacuum restricted to the Rindler patch. The lecture derives the thermal nature of the Rindler observer by noting that a thermal density matrix can be represented as a pure entangled state of two identical systems, where ignorance of one system produces the thermal state. Using the Schrödinger representation, the Minkowski vacuum wave functional is obtained from a Euclidean path integral and decomposed into a tensor product of left and right Rindler Hilbert spaces. It takes the form of an entangled sum over right and left Rindler energy eigenstates with coefficients involving the Rindler energies. Tracing out the inaccessible left Rindler patch yields a thermal density matrix for the right Rindler observer with inverse temperature $\beta = 2\pi$ in Rindler time $\eta$, demonstrating that the temperature arises because the Rindler observer cannot access the left patch. The same reasoning applies to black holes.

According to the Office for National Statistics, UK median disposable household income reached £27,300 in the financial year ending 2017, exceeding pre-2008 financial crisis levels by £1,600 after inflation. Incomes grew across society, but the poorest fifth gained most, rising by approximately £1,800 in real terms since the downturn, while the richest fifth saw gains of only around £200, causing income inequality to fall slightly over the past decade. The increase is attributed to rising employment and wages. However, a significant gap remains, with the richest fifth averaging £65,542 and the poorest £12,748 in disposable income. Retired households, with a median income of £22,300, are falling further behind non-retired households (£29,900), whose incomes rose faster at 3.5 per cent compared to 1.2 per cent.

The invention is a laser diode proximity sensor in a single integrated package. Prior art sensors use plastic housings, glass lenses, and glued central barriers, which create assembly difficulties, lens misalignment, glue voids or overflow, and unwanted internal light reflection. The disclosed sensor dispenses and cures drops of optical resin over the light-emitting diode and light sensor to form lenses. The assembly is then encapsulated in opaque molding compound that blocks cross-talk, eliminating the need for a plastic cap, central barrier, and adhesive. The light source is mounted directly on the light sensor chip to reduce footprint. Manufacturing includes attaching chips and diodes to a substrate array, wire bonding, dispensing and curing optical resin, encapsulating with molding compound, polishing to expose the lenses, optionally adding a protective baffle or metal cap, and singulating into individual modules. This provides lower cost, greater ruggedness and reliability, simplified manufacturing, and higher yields. Alternative embodiments include glass lenses with patterned apertures placed over the optical resin with an intervening air gap, a central black glue stopper between the diode and sensor, an LED on a separate conductive lead paired with reference and data light sensors for calibration, and a portable sensor stick containing environmental, light, motion, and wireless connectivity sensors for use with computing devices.

Research for the Association of British Insurers found British fire safety tests for building materials are inadequate after the Grenfell Tower fire. Tests use only wood rather than plastics present in real fires, and cladding is tested as sealed units rather than with real-world gaps and vents. The ABI called for non-combustible materials, reformed testing, and mandatory sprinklers in certain new buildings.

Japanese Finance Minister Taro Aso warned North Korea tensions make the yen extremely unstable despite its safe-haven status. He declined to comment on exchange rates, saying currencies should be set by markets. Aso said Japan and 10 others should proceed with the Trans-Pacific Partnership without the U.S., adding Washington would find rejoining better than bilateral deals.

Arsenal will visit Tottenham Hotspur for the 50th North London derby during Arsene Wenger's reign, having won 18, drawn 21 and lost 10 of the previous 49 meetings. Arsenal hope to hinder Tottenham's title challenge against leaders Chelsea. Tottenham fan Mike Leigh predicts a 2-1 home win, stating the midfield battle will be decisive and highlighting the intense rivalry. Arsenal fan Akhil Vyas says recent victories have boosted confidence but acknowledges Spurs will finish above Arsenal for the first time in over 20 years; he predicts a 1-1 draw or 2-1 Arsenal win, while noting Wenger's future remains debated despite the FA Cup semi-final victory.

Colorado Governor John Hickenlooper will testify before California's State Governance and Finance Committee on February 14 regarding Colorado's recreational cannabis regulatory experience. California seeks guidance to meet Proposition 64's January 1, 2018 deadline for establishing regulations. Senator Mike McGuire, chairing the hearing, stated the timeline is unrealistic and that California's Track and Trace program and tax collection will not be ready by then. The hearing aims to establish an implementation timeline and learn from Colorado.

Developmental research indicates that belief in Santa and its eventual abandonment are positive cognitive achievements associated with benefits like counterfactual reasoning and emotional growth. While most children adopt and later question the myth by around age eight, parents can choose to extend belief, let children reason independently, or provide disconfirming evidence. Children generally react positively to discovering the truth and understand such lies are well-intentioned. Experts recommend modest gifts from Santa so children from all income levels feel equally loved.

Automation Anywhere's Bot Store doubled bot numbers in two months. Artificial intelligence is the most popular category with 24 bots, speech-to-text leads downloads, finance and accounting is the top business process, and SAP is the most prevalent application with 31 bots. With IQ Bot, developers can now offer cognitive bots with computer vision, natural language processing, and machine learning to automate document-centric processes. Bots run on the Automation Anywhere Enterprise platform and can be combined to automate complex business processes.

Jacques Dubochet, Joachim Frank, and Richard Henderson won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for developing cryo-electron microscopy, which freezes biomolecules mid-movement to create detailed atomic-level images without destroying biological material. Frank developed mathematical models to sharpen images, Henderson generated 3-D protein images at atomic resolution, and Dubochet vitrified water to prevent diffraction. The $1.1 million award recognizes work deemed decisive for understanding life's chemistry and developing pharmaceuticals.

This patent application continuation describes pin trap mechanisms for a surgical linear cutter, or stapler, having a cartridge half and an anvil half configured to clamp, cut, and staple tissue. The document details an exemplary stapler structure—including a cartridge channel, clamp lever, firing assembly, staple cartridge, and retaining assembly—and explains its operation from coupling to firing. It further presents various mechanisms to releasably couple the proximal ends of the stapler halves while maintaining a predetermined maximum angular “hang open” or “open aperture” state, allowing single-handed manipulation without unintentional decoupling. Exemplary embodiments include longitudinally translatable locking slides (distally or proximally biased) that capture or release a proximal pivot pin; a proximally-biased retention pin on the anvil half engaging a camming surface on the cartridge half; C-clip retainers with pivotable ejector levers or translatable ejector slides; proximally-biased slides with camming release or separation surfaces; a pair of longitudinally outwardly biased opposing slides; and a rotatable locking member with a torque arm that releases the pin upon further opening. These configurations enable intuitive operator actuation via buttons or levers to separate the halves when desired. Exemplary claim combinations are also provided.

QuantifiedStrategies.com publishes articles on trading strategies for commodities, forex, ETFs, and technical indicators, covering assets such as gold, crude oil, copper, agricultural futures, CHFJPY, and GDX. The content explains various methodologies—including trend following, mean reversion, spread trading, fundamental analysis, arbitrage, and options trading—and often includes backtests, rules, and performance data. The website is operated by independent traders Hakan Samuelsson and Oddmund Groette, who share insights drawn from over 20 years of trading experience.

The speaker says that three seasons of playoff experience, including overtime games and coming back from down in series, have made the team more relaxed and prepared. They describe their team as reasonably physical and well-sized, without a distinct speed disadvantage against opponents. They reflect that while reaching the finals was previously exciting, the real thrill is winning, as demonstrated by beating Colorado.

The article details a Python-coded trading strategy combining the 14-day Relative Strength Index (RSI) and a 5-day Simple Moving Average (SMA). It uses the yfinance library to download historical price data, such as for Walmart (WMT), S&P 500 (SPY), and Nasdaq 100 (QQQ). The strategy generates buy signals when the RSI is below 30 and the closing price exceeds the SMA, and sell signals when the RSI is above 70 and the closing price is below the SMA. The article explains the formulas for RSI and SMA, demonstrates how to calculate them in Python using pandas, and shows how to create signals and an equity curve to measure performance. Key performance metrics include annual return, average gain per trade, win ratio, time invested, maximum drawdown, and risk-adjusted return.

Private equity billionaire Tony James is backing a new life sciences investment firm led by a former Flagship associate, the firm told STAT exclusively. Other updates include Sarepta’s Duchenne drug Medicaid setback, Amgen’s cholesterol shot preventing heart problems, the Trump administration backing off 100% pharma tariffs, Colorado’s payment limit on an Amgen drug, Orca’s T cell therapy FDA submission, TCGX’s $1.3 billion fund, and Skye’s obesity drug failing a mid-stage study.

This document standardizes the Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) for AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization–Encrypted State (SEV-ES) and Secure Nested Paging (SEV-SNP), enabling a guest OS to interoperate with any compatible hypervisor. SEV-ES and SEV-SNP encrypt guest register state during world switches, classifying VMEXITS as Automatic Exits (AE), which require no state exposure, or Non-Automatic Exits (NAE), where the guest selectively shares state via the GHCB. The GHCB is a 4KB decrypted page that mirrors the SEV-ES VMCB save state area to minimize guest state exposure during VMGEXIT. Version 2 introduces hypervisor feature advertisement through a FEATURES bitmap, initial SEV-SNP support, and enhancements including 64-bit guest request message sequence numbers, VLEK certificate GUIDs, APIC ID list retrieval, multi-VMPL execution, Page State Change support for SEV-ES guests, SEV-TIO trusted I/O, and Secure AVIC. The GHCB MSR protocol supports protocol negotiation, CPUID requests, AP reset hold, GHCB GPA registration and unregistration, Page State Change requests, Run VMPL, feature support queries, and termination requests. For NAE events, the guest copies required register state into the GHCB, invokes VMGEXIT, and retrieves hypervisor results. Supported NAE events include IOIO_PROT, MSR_PROT, VMMCALL, #NPF/MMIO access, Page State Change, SNP Guest Request, SNP Extended Guest Request, SNP AP Creation, #HV Doorbell Page, #HV Send IPI, #HV Timer, APIC ID List, SNP Run VMPL, SNP TIO Guest Request, Secure AVIC backing page registration, and Termination Request. SEV-SNP guests must register the GHCB GPA before first use. SMP booting relies on AP Reset Hold and AP Jump Table mechanisms, while SEV-SNP adds AP Creation via VMSA pages. NMI handling requires the hypervisor to avoid intercepting IRET and to use a guest-issued "NMI Complete" message. The SEV-SNP Secrets Page includes a Guest Reserved Area for message sequence numbers and the AP jump table address, and an EFI Confidential Computing Blob protocol communicates the Secrets Page and CPUID Page to the OS. Restricted Injection uses a shared #HV doorbell page for hypervisor event notification. Page State Change operations allow transitions to private or shared pages and include PSMASH and UNSMASH hints. System Management Mode and nested virtualization are not supported.

Sebastian Vettel won the 2018 Bahrain Grand Prix, holding off Valtteri Bottas by 0.699 seconds despite struggling with worn tyres on a one-stop strategy. Bottas finished second and Lewis Hamilton third after starting ninth. Both Red Bulls retired early: Daniel Ricciardo with an electrical issue and Max Verstappen after first-lap damage. Kimi Raikkonen retired following a pit-stop incident in which he hit a mechanic. Pierre Gasly finished fourth for Toro Rosso-Honda, giving Honda its best result since its 2015 return. Kevin Magnussen was fifth, Nico Hulkenberg sixth, and Fernando Alonso seventh. Marcus Ericsson finished ninth for Sauber, and Esteban Ocon took 10th.

The Stochastic Indicator Strategy is a technical analysis tool used to identify potential trend reversals and overbought/oversold conditions by comparing a security’s closing price to its price range over a set period, typically producing two lines: %K and %D. Overbought conditions are generally signaled above 80 and oversold below 20, with traders interpreting %K and %D crossovers and divergence for entry and exit signals. A backtest on the S&P 500 ETF SPY from its 1993 inception showed 556 trades, an average return of 0.57% per trade, a profit factor of 2.2, and a maximum drawdown of 19.8%, indicating short lookback periods work best. The strategy applies to various markets and timeframes, but adjustable parameters should match specific market conditions. It may generate false signals in ranging, low-volatility, or highly volatile markets and can lag during strong trends. Traders are advised to combine it with other indicators, employ risk management such as stop-losses and diversification, and avoid relying solely on default settings or isolated signals.

KeyBanc downgraded Fortinet from Overweight to Sector Weight, citing weakened long-term operating margin expansion targets and potential return to "spend mode." Despite significant stock gains and valuations not being historically expensive, the risk-reward profile is less favorable. Shares fell 2.5 percent Monday.

Hawking died at 76 after submitting a paper with Thomas Hertog 10 days prior. "A Smooth Exit from Eternal Inflation?" discusses multiverse theory of parallel universes and suggests universe's death as stars lose energy. It is being considered for publication. Hawking never won a Nobel Prize; it isn't given posthumously.

Thousands of schools across the country closed on Monday due to snow. Due to continued icy weather, several schools in and around the Warwick District and Rugby Borough remain closed Tuesday, with a list of closures that may be updated.

The IRS tax deadline is April 17, with extensions available. Taxpayers have three years to claim refunds before becoming Treasury property; the IRS holds $1.1 billion in unclaimed 2014 refunds for 1 million non-filers. No penalty applies for late filing if due a refund, and those below filing requirements may still qualify. The IRS may file substitute returns without credits or deductions. Those owing taxes face late fees, collection notices, installment agreements, and if over $25,000 remains unpaid, asset levies or seizure. Communication avoids serious trouble.

This retrospective study using the TriNetX database investigated the impact of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) on cardiovascular outcomes in patients with cancer therapy-related cardiac dysfunction (CTRCD). The study included adults with a history of cancer and cardiotoxic antineoplastic therapy-induced cardiomyopathy who received optimal guideline-directed medical therapy, comparing 1,223 propensity-score-matched GLP-1 RA users with 1,223 non-users. Over a one-year follow-up, the GLP-1 RA group had significantly lower rates of a primary composite outcome of heart failure exacerbation, all-cause mortality, and hospital or emergency department admissions (55.7% versus 68.9%; p < 0.001), as well as significant reductions in secondary outcomes of mortality, heart failure, and all-cause hospitalization (all p < 0.001). No significant differences were observed for atrial fibrillation or flutter, ventricular tachycardia, or the falsification outcome of gastroenteritis. The authors conclude that GLP-1 RAs are a promising therapeutic option for reducing mortality, heart failure exacerbations, and hospital admissions in patients with CTRCD, noting limitations including the observational design, reliance on electronic health records, and short one-year follow-up.

Indices rose Thursday morning: Nifty at 10,641, Sensex at 34,994. HDFC Bank, Reliance Communications, ONGC and Coal India led gains. Breadth favoured advances; 38 stocks hit 52-week lows. Reliance Industries Ltd. is the sole beneficiary of Independent Media Trust which controls Network18 Media & Investments Ltd.

Jane Goodall told TIME conservation is more urgent than ever, citing climate change as the greatest long-term threat while remaining cautiously optimistic. Ahead of the documentary "Jane," she urged viewers to understand chimpanzees and act before worst impacts become irreversible.

A Tennessee woman's video of her son Keaton describing middle school bullying—being called ugly, having milk poured on him, and ham put down his clothes—gained over 18 million views and prompted support from athletes and celebrities including Delanie Walker, Tyler Byrd, Kelsea Ballerini, Dale Earnhardt Jr., and Snoop Dogg. A crowdsourcing page for Keaton's future education raised over $29,000.

Saudi Aramco cut May prices for lighter crude grades to Asian customers while leaving medium and heavy grades unchanged, competing with U.S. shale and other non-OPEC suppliers. Despite OPEC and allies' output cuts, the reductions aim to preserve market share in Asia, where Middle Eastern crude's import share fell from 65.9 percent in January to 61.5 percent in March while Western exporters' share rose to 19.7 percent. The cuts contrast with recent modest increases in Brent-Dubai swaps. By reducing heavier crude shipments to meet output cut commitments while discounting lighter grades, Saudi Arabia could create a light crude surplus and heavy crude deficit in Asia, putting Brent-Dubai swaps into discount for the first time in seven years.

Enron Corp. replaced Chief Financial Officer Andrew Fastow with Jeff McMahon, head of the industrial markets group and former treasurer, on October 24–25, 2001. The company said the change was needed to restore investor confidence amid a Securities and Exchange Commission inquiry into partnerships run by Fastow (LJM Cayman and LJM2), which were involved in transactions that led to a $1.2 billion reduction in shareholder equity and $35 million in losses. Enron’s stock fell 17% to $16.41 on October 24 and had declined roughly 50% over the preceding week. Analysts downgraded the stock, citing concerns over complex off-balance-sheet deals, inadequate disclosure, and potential further liabilities. McMahon had previously raised internal concerns about Fastow’s role in the partnerships. The turmoil also depressed shares of other energy traders, and multiple shareholder lawsuits were filed against Enron alleging misleading disclosures.

Welles told the Finnish Minister that U.S. relations with Finland could not remain normal if Finland assisted Germany against the Soviet Union and warned against major offensives. Hull directed the U.S. Minister in Sweden to urge Swedish officials to persuade Finland not to undertake further offensives against the USSR and to seek peace, citing a speech by President Ryti. The U.S. Minister in Finland reported a new German-Finnish trade agreement emphasizing their "common struggle," with Finland pledging to deliver maximum forestry and industrial goods to Germany.
Perforated Mylar disk parachutes unfurl via kirigami for humanitarian aid or package delivery.

A December 11, 2017 article in Future Oncology reported that in patients with metastatic Merkel cell carcinoma, non-progression during avelumab treatment correlated with gains in health-related quality of life. Using JAVELIN Merkel 200 Phase II trial data, researchers found that tumor reduction under avelumab correlated with improved health status measured by HRQoL instruments.

The passage describes a respiratory assistance system and method for delivering heated and humidified respiratory gases to a patient. The system includes a gas source, a humidification chamber containing a volume of liquid, a chamber heater, an inspiratory conduit, a patient interface, and a controller comprising one or more hardware processors. The controller determines one or more characteristics of the respiratory gases—such as mean flow rate, breathing pattern, bias flow rate, rebreathing, inlet temperature, or the presence of hardware components like an expiratory conduit detected via voltage, impedance, or resistance measurements—to determine the type of gas source, for example an air entraining or non-air entraining ventilator. Based on this determination, the controller controls operating parameters including a chamber heater set point temperature and power delivery to optimize humidity, mimic conditions of unassisted inspiration, improve system performance, increase patient comfort, and reduce condensation. The system can automatically determine its operational configuration, confirm user inputs against sensor measurements, operate in a safety mode prior to confirmation, and generate user indicators.

This cross-sectional study in Nigeria evaluated 248 adults (128 HIV-positive, 120 HIV-negative) grouped by HIV status and occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals. The study measured apoptotic markers (p53, bcl2), oxidative stress indicators (MDA, 8OHdG), antioxidant enzyme (SOD), and CD4 counts. HIV-positive exposed participants had significantly lower p53 and bcl2 levels and significantly higher MDA compared to HIV-negative unexposed individuals. HIV-positive groups had significantly lower CD4 counts than HIV-negative groups regardless of occupational exposure. Multiple linear regression showed HIV status and SOD activity were significantly associated with p53 and bcl2. The authors conclude that immune deficiency, oxidative stress, antioxidant deficits, and dysregulation of apoptosis may increase genomic instability and cancer risk in HIV-infected individuals occupationally exposed to chemical mixtures, and that optimal SOD levels may be essential for p53 to maintain genomic stability.

The speaker, coaching the Capitals in the Stanley Cup Finals against the defending champion Detroit Red Wings and coach Scotty Bowman, states his team is not intimidated and benefits from veteran leaders like Brian Bellows and Tikkanen, who help teammates relax in pressure situations. He credits strong support from George McPhee, assistant coaches, and management including Mr. Pollin, Susan O'Malley, and Dick Patrick, and notes players dedicated games to family members to emphasize community support. He praises Bowman's adaptability, plans flexible matchups, and highlights Dale Hunter's importance to team unity. He views the goaltending matchup between Olie and Chris Osgood as even, noting neither has won a Stanley Cup by himself.

This study reconstructs SARS-CoV-2 Omicron lineage replacement dynamics in Connecticut from January 2022 to January 2023 using genomic surveillance data, epidemiological modeling, and clinical metadata. Following the emergence of BA.1 in late 2021, consecutive sweeps by BA.2, co-circulating BA.4 and BA.5, and finally XBB sustained high community transmission throughout 2022, causing an estimated 1.5 million BA.1 infections, over 2.1 million combined BA.2/BA.4/BA.5 infections, and roughly 0.4 million XBB infections. Lineage replacement slowed over time: BA.1 rose from 5% to 50% frequency in 10 days, whereas XBB required 59 days. Reproduction number ratios showed BA.1 and BA.2 had large transmissibility advantages over their predecessors (78.4% and 76%, respectively), while later lineages showed smaller advantages. Analysis of RT-qPCR cycle threshold values from over 6,800 Omicron samples indicated that higher viral copy number was not consistently decisive for a lineage’s competitive success. Vaccine breakthrough infection odds were significantly elevated during BA.1’s emergence, but not during BA.2’s; BA.5 and XBB showed non-significant tendencies. The authors propose a conceptual susceptible-infected-recovered model in which BA.1 opened a novel antigenic space, BA.2 outcompeted it through higher intrinsic transmissibility, BA.4/BA.5 escaped to a second antigenic space, and XBB combined extensive immune escape with higher intrinsic transmissibility to outcompete BA.5. The findings demonstrate that variant fitness depends on a dynamic interplay between intrinsic transmissibility and immune escape, shaped by the host population’s antigenic exposure history.

This study examines the relationship between Subjective Survival Probabilities (SSP) and work/employment among Japanese adults aged 50 and over. The lecture examines entry in industrial organization using two-stage models where potential entrants pay a sunk cost and then compete in prices or quantities. The equilibrium number of firms is determined by backward induction, with entry occurring until variable profits cover the fixed cost. With homogeneous goods, entry is generally excessive—often by a large margin—because entrants impose a business stealing effect on incumbents, capturing private benefits that exceed the social benefit of increased output. In heterogeneous goods models, entry may be excessive or insufficient depending on whether the business stealing effect outweighs consumer surplus gains from better product matches; a Hotelling example produces twice the socially optimal number of firms.

The lecture also distinguishes vertical differentiation cases: a natural oligopoly, where even vanishing fixed costs yield only a finite number of firms because all consumers should buy the highest quality, versus a specialization case, where different consumers prefer different qualities and infinite entry is possible.

Regarding firm dynamics, census data reveals substantial entry and exit. Jovanovic’s 1982 model explains this through firms learning their unknown cost types over time: small, uncertain firms grow faster and fail more often, while larger, established firms earn higher profits. Industry concentration correlates with profits and profit variance due to underlying cost heterogeneity rather than market power alone.

Finally, Vellodi’s work on rating intermediaries analyzes how platforms like Amazon or Yelp affect entry when new firms must learn their quality through consumer reviews. Because new entrants learn slowly, a consumer-welfare-maximizing platform should adopt a partially revealing policy that restricts information about the highest-quality firms, thereby incentivizing newer firms to price below cost to attract reviews and improve their reputations.

GAO report GAO-24-105648 examines Comprehensive Support and Improvement (CSI) schools under the Elementary and Secondary Education Act. A nationally generalizable sample of CSI plans showed an estimated 42 percent addressed all three selected required elements: a school-level needs assessment, identification of resource inequities, and evidence-based interventions. Specifically, about 73 percent appeared based on a needs assessment, 52 percent identified resource inequities, and 86 percent included interventions, though only 58 percent cited interventions supported by the Department of Education’s What Works Clearinghouse, while 18 percent cited interventions shown to be ineffective. This study investigates sodium homeostasis in structural connectivity hubs in drug-resistant focal epilepsy (DRFE) using ultra-high-field 7T sodium-23 MRI. Twenty-three patients and twenty-one healthy controls underwent MRI, and epileptogenic (EZ), propagation (PZ), and non-involved (NIZ) zones were defined via stereoelectroencephalography. Structural connectomes derived from diffusion MRI identified hub regions.

Results showed that total sodium concentration (TSC) was globally elevated in patients compared to controls, both within and outside the EZ, and correlated with EZ network extent. The sodium signal fraction (f) was specifically increased in the EZ but decreased in non-EZ regions. Hub parcels exhibited higher TSC than non-hub parcels in both patients and controls, while f did not differ between hub and non-hub regions. Patient alterations in TSC and f were independent of hub status. Canonical structural hubs (e.g., precuneus, thalamus, dorso-frontal cortex) were rarely involved in the EZ.

The authors conclude that increased TSC in hubs likely reflects general microstructural characteristics and wiring cost rather than epilepsy-specific pathology. In contrast, the elevated f ratio in the EZ may serve as a marker of regional susceptibility to homeostasis failure and supports the concept of the EZ as an isolated, autonomous network rather than a pathological hub. Future research should examine the relationship between sodium relaxometry, functional connectivity, and epileptogenic network dynamics.
