A preliminary report on Chicago stockyards by Reynolds and Neill is transmitted to Congress, urging immediate legislation for federal inspection of stockyards, packing houses, and meat products in interstate or foreign commerce. The report describes revolting, unclean, and dangerous conditions that existing law cannot remedy, leaving interstate commerce open to uninspected meats. The message recommends funding inspection through a fee per slaughtered animal, not exceeding eight cents per head, because insufficient appropriations could otherwise defeat the law's purpose. It warns that without legislation, abuses will certainly recur, and urges enactment of the Beveridge amendment (Senate amendment No. 29) to empower the Department of Agriculture to inspect products, supervise preparation methods, and prescribe sanitary conditions.

A 26-year-old man was arrested and remains in custody after allegedly threatening two people with a firearm at Shackleton Court in Newton Heath on Monday at around 4:30pm. Armed officers attended the scene, the incident lasted several hours, and negotiators were understood to be called in.

Andrea Conti's agent Mario Giuffredi said the wing-back only wants Milan and his Atalanta time is over. Giuffredi criticized coach Gian Piero Gasperini over the transfer, arguing it is unfair to stop Conti's dream, adding everyone works to improve professionally and economically.

This paper investigates the complexity of ML-definability and ML-separability for modal µ-calculus (µML) formulae across classes of models including all models, words, binary trees, and d-ary trees for d ≥ 3. Over all models and binary trees, ML-separability is ExpTime-complete, matching ML-definability. Over words, both problems are PSpace-complete. Over d-ary trees with d ≥ 3, ML-separability is 2-ExpTime-complete, strictly harder than ML-definability (ExpTime). The paper also establishes separator construction complexities, proves ML lacks the Craig interpolation property over d-ary trees for d ≥ 3 (where interpolant existence is coNExpTime-complete), and extends results to the graded µ-calculus, where ML-separability is 2-ExpTime-complete while ML-definability remains ExpTime-complete.

The DAWN-PLASMA study was a randomized, multicenter, open-label, phase II trial evaluating the efficacy and safety of convalescent plasma added to standard care in hospitalized COVID-19 patients. Approved by Independent Ethics Committees and conducted in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki and ICH GCP guidelines, the study required informed consent and enrolled adults with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection who were not receiving mechanical ventilation. Between May 2020 and January 2021, 489 patients were randomized 2:1 to receive four units (800–1000 mL) of high-neutralizing-antibody-titer convalescent plasma plus standard care or standard care alone. The primary endpoint, the proportion of patients alive and free of mechanical ventilation at Day 15, showed no significant difference between the convalescent plasma and control groups (83.7% versus 84.1%). No significant differences were observed in secondary endpoints, mortality, or safety outcomes, including serious adverse events. Transfusion-related side effects occurred in 6% of the intervention group. Higher neutralizing antibody titers at baseline and Day 6 correlated with better clinical outcomes, but the plasma intervention did not significantly increase titers or alter the natural course of the disease compared to standard care.

Coach DeBoer said the home crowd and sleeping at home matter in the playoffs, but the team must limit distractions and focus. He said they need to improve support and positioning against the opponent's speed, possess the puck more, attack more, and force penalty calls. He noted they are not overreacting to their hole, citing a past Devils series, and acknowledged matchup problems from Crosby, Malkin, and Kessel on three lines. He added the series will feature momentum swings, they will not dominate for long stretches as in past series, and they must avoid frustration.

This study employs quantitative bibliometric and factorial analysis to examine 34 English-language Scopus documents on STEAM education with gamification published between 2017 and 2023. Publication output grew from 4 documents in 2020 to a peak of 8 in 2022. The most cited article is Wannapiroon and Pimdee (2022) with 30 citations. Leading authors include Kummanee, Nilsook, and Wannapiroon, each with 3 publications and 25 citations. Thailand produced the most publications (6) and citations (68), followed by Bulgaria, Italy, and Malaysia (3 documents each). CEUR Workshop Proceedings is the most productive source. Computer science represents 37.7% of papers, social sciences 20.5%, and engineering 16.9%. Predominant keywords include gamification, steam, steam education, and computational thinking. Malaysia achieved the highest total link strength in country collaboration, while Germany, Latvia, Norway, and France form prominent research clusters. Factorial analysis identifies three clusters—educational methodologies and tools, student-centered learning environments, and educational technologies with engagement strategies—accounting for 66.69% of data variance. The findings indicate that STEAM education with gamification is an emerging and expanding research field.

A&O Shearman associate Ashley Hollis won "Big Brother" by hiding her legal profession and posing as a social media marketer. She channeled Elle Woods, letting others think they could manipulate her while using attorney skills to deliver the winning speech. She plans to give much of her $750,000 prize to her parents and is thinking about buying a home.

Tharisa plc held an investor presentation led by CEO Phoevos Pouroulis, joined by CFO Michael Jones, Managing Director Vulela Makuni, and Executive Roy Murley. The company announced its transition from open pit to underground mining after 15 years of open cast operations. Tharisa outlined its vision of a fully integrated mining complex, noting 11 years of profitability while coproducing Platinum Group Metals and chrome concentrate.

Arthur Santiago and Cristiano Mattos describe a remote educational intervention during the COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil, grounded in Cultural Historical Activity Theory and Paulo Freire’s critical pedagogy. In a non-formal education course for physics teacher education, they used the Discord platform to facilitate dialogic activity with 19 students. The seven-stage activity engaged students in investigating the contradiction of school reopening during the pandemic and producing a scientific dissemination infographic. Leveraging Discord’s persistent channels and unmanaged access, students self-organized groups, held autonomous meetings, and collaborated synchronously and asynchronously. The study found that combining Freirean dialogic methodology with Discord’s affordances fostered student agency, expanded conscious awareness of socio-political contradictions, and enabled students to connect personal experiences with collective problems while distributing tasks based on their technological skills.
Libyan National Army forces in Benghazi suffered four dead and 10 wounded in December, five months after declaring victory, as clashes continue.

The passage describes systems, methods, and articles of manufacture for electronic gaming machines that provide a stop-based bonus game. The bonus game includes a construct—such as a wheel, reel, dice, or grid—with stop positions associated with either first awards (e.g., jackpot awards) or second awards (e.g., credit prizes or non-jackpot awards). When a trigger event occurs, a stop position is selected; if it is associated with a second award, that award is given to the player and the stop position is then associated with a first award for future play, increasing subsequent chances of winning a first award. These associations may persist across plays and players until a first award is won, after which stop positions may reset to default associations. The gaming system includes a processor, memory, display, player input interface, and credit input mechanism. In some implementations, a bonus wheel triggers a secondary jackpot wheel where a selected credit prize is awarded and then replaced by a jackpot award on that stop position.

This study examines a learning-by-teaching approach using generative AI in an introductory physics for life sciences course, where students prompt, validate, and iteratively refine AI-generated simulations of electric potential and equipotential lines. The research compared three quasi-experimental laboratory groups: a traditional physical equipment lab, a pre-built AI-designed simulation, and an AI-engagement lab where students constructed their own simulations using Claude AI. Data were collected through immediate conceptual questions, attitude surveys, and subsequent midterm and final exam performance.

Results indicated that students in both the AI-engaged and pre-built simulation groups performed significantly better on immediate conceptual assessments than those using physical equipment, with no significant difference between the two simulation groups. These performance differences did not persist on the midterm or final exams. Student attitudes were significantly more positive toward both digital methods compared to the physical lab, though the pre-built simulation group reported a more favorable comparison to prior labs than the AI-engaged group. The authors note that the AI-engaged approach may additionally foster scientific modeling and validation skills. Limitations include the study’s single-institution setting, homogeneous life-sciences student population, technical constraints of the free AI tier, and differing levels of abstraction across conditions. The study concludes that AI-assisted simulation development supports conceptual learning without compromising traditional educational goals, serving as a complementary tool alongside physical equipment and pre-built simulations.

U.S. President Donald Trump and Prime Minister Justin Trudeau met at the White House, projecting friendly relations despite trade imbalances and unresolved disputes over beef imports, supply management, and softwood lumber. Interim Conservative leader Rona Ambrose warned that Trump's deregulation and low-tax policies could make Canada uncompetitive but supported Trudeau not starting a fight with the president. Trudeau's diplomatic performance was called masterful. Trump was gracious, calling Canada "our great friend, neighbour and ally." A United States-Canada Council for Advancement of Women Entrepreneurs and Business Leaders was announced and a four-page communique issued supporting cooperation on trade, energy, border security, international alliances, and the fight against ISIS.

This March 2006 specification update documents silicon errata for the AMD Geode CS5535 Companion Device Silicon Revision A3. It lists non-sequentially numbered functional and timing issues across subsystems including DMA, PIC, PIT, GLIU, UART, LPC, IDE/ATA/UDMA, USB, ACPI/PMC, GPIO, SMB, PCI, RTC, and keyboard emulation. Each entry describes the failure, its implications, and often provides a workaround or resolution, while some issues have no fix. Typical workarounds include avoiding specific access modes, disabling clock gating, using DWORD alignment, and not using certain debug or power-management features. The document also contains AMD legal disclaimers and trademark notices.

Fran Horowitz, CEO of Abercrombie & Fitch, said the retailer aspires to be a “lifestyle brand” rather than chase trends. Since taking over in 2017, she dropped command-and-control management in favor of more employee input and raised clothing quality. A&F sales nearly doubled to $2.6 billion between 2019 and 2024, while combined sales with Hollister will top $5 billion this year. The company launched new partnerships, including Abercrombie Kids at Macy’s and an NFL fashion deal offering merchandise for female fans to build customer acquisition and brand awareness.
Toy-obsessed dogs may parallel human behavioral addictions and give clues to addictive behaviors.

Researchers from Stanford University's Department of Psychology found that college students chose identically prepared vegetables 25 percent more often when they had delicious-sounding descriptive labels versus basic labels, 35 percent more often than healthy-positive labels, and 41 percent more often than healthy-restrictive labels, and they took larger portions. Only about 10 percent of American adults and 1 percent of teens meet daily vegetable recommendations. A 2017 International Food Information Council Foundation survey found that 84 percent of consumers prioritize taste in purchases versus 63 percent who prioritize healthfulness. The passage suggests using appetizing names for vegetable dishes at home to encourage greater consumption.

The lecture discusses combining weak and electromagnetic interactions into electroweak theory. Differing interaction strengths are addressed by heavy gauge bosons, while differing coupling structures are handled by absorbing the (1 − γ⁵) term into spinor definitions, simplifying weak currents to vector currents. Neutrinos and electrons are grouped into left-handed doublets, with charged weak currents expressed via Pauli matrices. A neutral current appears from the third isospin component, and a hypercharge current—defined analogously to the Gell-Mann–Nishijima formula—incorporates right-handed particles. The framework uses an isospin triplet and a hypercharge singlet. The W⁺ and W⁻ bosons are combinations of the first two triplet components, while the photon and Z boson arise from mixing the third triplet component and the singlet via the weak mixing angle, unifying the interactions consistently.

The article gives five tips for the digital board game Abalone. Players should avoid rushing into offense and plan moves carefully to prevent vulnerabilities. Controlling the board's center increases mobility. While starting defensively, players must eventually attack, as removing five opponent counters leaves less scope for mistakes without punishment. Players should split opponent counters into smaller groups and corral them toward the edge, while watching for counter attacks. Asmodee Digital recently released an updated digital version.

NASA shared a Hubble image of the Tarantula Nebula, named for spidery gas filaments, and the Honeycomb Nebula, whose shape may come from two supernovae and the viewing angle. Hubble is a NASA/ESA project launched in 1990.

This cross-sectional study characterized Alzheimer’s disease (AD) plasma biomarkers in 1,067 elderly Amish individuals enrolled in the Collaborative Amish Aging and Memory Project. Compared to cognitively unimpaired (CU) individuals, those with AD had significantly higher plasma p-tau181 and lower Aβ42/p-tau181 ratios, though no significant differences were found for Aβ40, Aβ42, or Aβ42/Aβ40 between diagnostic groups. In multivariate analyses, no plasma biomarker showed a significant independent association with AD; however, the relationship between p-tau181 and AD was strongly moderated by APOE ε4 carrier status, with significantly increased p-tau181 observed only among carriers. Models incorporating all biomarkers or the Aβ42/p-tau181 ratio achieved the highest discriminative performance for AD (AUC = 0.83). For cognitive preservation, decreased p-tau181 and increased Aβ42/p-tau181 were significantly associated with better outcomes in sensitivity analyses excluding mild cognitive impairment. Using K-medoids clustering with Aβ42/Aβ40 and p-tau181, the analysis identified subgroups with distinct AD risk profiles; the high-risk cluster contained significantly more APOE ε4 carriers and individuals with AD. The authors conclude that plasma biomarkers—particularly p-tau181, Aβ42/Aβ40, and Aβ42/p-tau181—are promising non-invasive indicators for distinguishing AD and cognitive impairment in this population, though longitudinal validation is needed.

The passage describes an automated cryogenic storage system for biological or chemical samples, disclosed as a divisional of prior U.S. and international applications. The system includes one or more cryogenic storage vaults maintained at or below about −150°C and a Sample Handling Module (SHM) housing a sample transfer robot with a gripper. The SHM automatically transfers individual samples between vaults, internal trays, and docked removable cryogenic storage devices (portable cryogenic workstations), rapidly moving samples through non-cryogenic environments while keeping them below a cryogenic temperature threshold (e.g., −134°C). Samples are identified and tracked via barcodes. Each vault contains interleaved shelf groups rotated by external motors, vertical shuttle assemblies for tray transport, and primary and secondary refrigeration coils using liquid nitrogen to create a cold, dry gas bath. The SHM environment is non-cryogenic but humidity-controlled via refrigerant gas flows and a cryotrap dehumidification system. A controller manages transfers, tracks sample locations, monitors refrigeration and humidity, and executes disaster recovery protocols, including multi-stage procedures for jammed trays that may require manual intervention or complete vault disassembly. A camera module adapted for ultra-low temperatures is also described.

Stefanski stated there is no single requirement for Sanders to earn the role but emphasized Sanders needs further development before he is ready, likely keeping him as the third-string quarterback. This application relates to deuterated heterocycle fused gamma-carbolines of Formulas I–IV and pharmaceutically acceptable salts (e.g., tosylate), which antagonize 5-HT2A receptors, inhibit the serotonin transporter, and modulate dopaminergic signaling. Deuterium incorporation at the N-methyl and adjacent methylene positions limits metabolism via N-dealkylation and alpha-oxidation, yielding improved metabolic stability over the non-deuterated compound of Formula Q. The invention provides pharmaceutical compositions, including immediate, sustained, depot, and osmotic-controlled oral delivery formulations, and methods for treating central nervous system disorders such as schizophrenia (including residual symptoms), depression, anxiety, sleep disorders, and Parkinson’s disease. Comparative pharmacokinetic studies in mice, rats, and dogs show that the deuterated compounds generate substantially lower plasma levels of the N-demethylated/alpha-oxidized amide metabolite Q-1 and des-methyl metabolite Q-1A than the non-deuterated congener, while retaining similar receptor binding profiles.

Kennedy Jr. The newsletter also lists articles on the Texas measles outbreak, Supreme Court conversion therapy case, work requirements, dementia terminology, telehealth, pharmaceutical tariffs, Colorado drug pricing, and FDA criticism.

The "Triangle Rotation" offense attacks the triangle zone in a Triangle & Two defense via a simple three-player rotation, using two shooters if inside options fail. Key actions include elbow penetration, pop-out shots, baseline cuts, lob passes, and side screens. As a secondary offense, it requires simplicity, execution, zone-attack fundamentals, and team coordination. Coaches should teach it using the whole-part-whole method, scout opponents to anticipate defensive reads, vary alignments, and attack weak defenders. In a Triangle & Two defense, three players form a zone while two chasers deny passes and rebounds.

Two government studies found a weak link between high-dose cellphone radiation and rare heart tumors in male rats, but no significant problems in female rats or mice, and no clear evidence of brain tumors. Federal regulators and scientists, including the study's lead author and the FDA, maintain that cellphones are safe, noting typical human exposure is far lower than the radiation levels used in the nine-hour daily tests. While critics argue excessive use may pose a hazard, major studies have found little evidence of cancer risk in humans, and experts say the findings do not warrant changing cellphone habits.

Michael Johnson, provost of Babson College, has been named president of John Carroll University, its first lay leader in 131 years. The board approved a five-year contract on Dec. 6; Johnson, 61, begins July 1, replacing the retiring Rev. Robert Niehoff. Johnson previously taught at the University of Michigan for 24 years and served as dean at Cornell's School of Hotel Administration for 10 years. He holds degrees from the University of Wisconsin-Madison and the University of Chicago, and will also join the JCU faculty.

This systematic review evaluated the accuracy and validity of ChatGPT responses in education by analyzing 18 empirical, peer-reviewed studies from Google Scholar, Web of Science, and EBSCO, with searches conducted up to 26 October 2023. The study found that ChatGPT generates coherent, well-structured text and can pass many undergraduate exams across various disciplines, sometimes outperforming students on writing tasks. However, it struggles with complex scientific problems, advanced calculations, and tasks requiring deep understanding, critical thinking, and reasoning. Its responses may contain hallucinations, false information presented confidently, or inconsistent answers to repeated prompts, and plagiarism detection software cannot reliably identify its output. The author proposes an "ABCD framework" for institutions to adopt ChatGPT, recommending content validation, carefully structured prompts, redesigned assessments focusing on higher-order skills, authentic assessment design, institutional guidelines, and student training. The review concludes that while ChatGPT has educational potential, its responses are not fully accurate or reliable, particularly in scientific fields, and cooperation between educators and developers is needed to improve educational applications.

The President reports to Congress that the nation has grown in strength, knowledge, and peace, though it faces problems of growth. In foreign relations, the United States is at peace; it has promoted the Kellogg-Briand Pact and plans to adhere to the amended International Court of Justice, while participating in a London naval conference to limit arms. Marines remain in Nicaragua, Haiti, and China, but the government seeks to withdraw them as conditions permit and proposes a commission to review the Haitian situation while pursuing further reductions in China and Nicaragua. Diplomatic missions to Latin America are to be strengthened.

National defense spending has risen sharply since 1924, and the President urges prudent relief from mounting expenditures, noting that forces are ample and should be proportioned to defensive needs under the Kellogg Pact. Government finances are sound; the public debt has decreased significantly, and the President recommends income and corporation tax reductions to benefit small and moderate incomes. Settlements of foreign debts are nearly complete, with agreements concluded or pending with Austria, Greece, and France; only Russia and Armenia remain unsettled. Alien enemy property is largely being returned.

Following a wave of speculation and the stock market crash, the administration instituted voluntary cooperation with business and governments to maintain wages, continue fundamental business, and expand construction to prevent unemployment and restore confidence. Agriculture is improving, with rising gross farm income; the Federal Farm Board is organizing cooperative marketing for grain, cotton, livestock, and wool to increase farmers' bargaining power and control surpluses.

The President reaffirms principles for limited tariff revision to aid agriculture and industries suffering from post-1922 economic shifts, advocating preservation of the flexible tariff with more expeditious cost determinations. He recommends expanded authorizations for public buildings, increased appropriations for rivers, harbors, and flood control, and continued federal aid for highways, especially farm-to-market roads. The Post Office deficit exceeds $80 million annually, requiring study, while commercial aviation has grown remarkably under federal airway and mail support.

Railroads are in good condition, but legislation is needed to expedite consolidations and relieve the Interstate Commerce Commission of minor matters. The merchant marine transfer to private enterprise proceeds under the 1928 act, though mail contract ambiguities require congressional clarification and additional vessel construction is proposed. The banking law should be revised to address group and chain banking, national bank charter competition, and possible branch banking, potentially through a joint commission.

The Federal Power Commission should become a full-time body with extended interstate authority, and the Radio Commission should be made permanent with zone requirements abolished. Muscle Shoals should be leased, with revenues dedicated to agricultural chemistry research, through a special negotiating commission. Boulder Dam power contracts should assure repayment before work begins. Conservation efforts address oil and gas permit abuses, overgrazing, and reclamation policy through a new commission.

Federal social service should remain limited to research, subsidies, and leadership, with conferences planned on child health, housing, and recreation. Public health should be organized through local and state units, with continued Sheppard-Towner funds coordinated through the Children's Bureau and Public Health Service. New federal prisons, a Bureau of Prisons, and reorganized probation and parole are urgently needed. Immigration quotas should be studied to prioritize fitness and national need. Veterans' benefits have expanded significantly; the President proposes consolidating the Pension Bureau, National Home, and Veterans' Bureau into a single agency. Civil service coverage should extend to third-class postmasters.

Departmental reorganization is essential, grouping related activities under single-headed responsibility and separating executive from quasi-legislative functions; this requires Congress to delegate authority to the Executive subject to congressional review. Prohibition enforcement should be concentrated in the Department of Justice, with simplified court procedures, codification of laws, and a unified border patrol; a National Commission on Law Observance and Enforcement is studying broader problems. The President concludes that the test of decisions lies in advancing American ideals of self-government, justice, liberty, opportunity, and peace.

This study assessed awareness, attitudes, and factors influencing decisions regarding labor epidural analgesia (LEA) among 230 third-trimester pregnant women at Hemen Medical Center in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, via a cross-sectional survey conducted from June to August 2024. Although 78% of participants had heard of LEA, only 6.5% identified healthcare providers as their primary source of information, and only 14.3% were willing to consider LEA during delivery. Hesitancy was driven by concerns about maternal side effects, fetal safety, interference with natural labor, and cost. Multivariable logistic regression identified higher education (degree or above), monthly family income greater than 25,000 ETB, belief in LEA’s pain-relief effectiveness, and absence of perceived fetal risk as factors significantly associated with the decision to receive LEA. The authors concluded that despite relatively high awareness, low willingness reflects inadequate explanations from healthcare providers and persistent misconceptions, underscoring the need for comprehensive health education and counseling during antenatal care to promote informed decision-making.

The speaker highlights the team’s puck-pursuit game as a strength that tires opponents. Sid is praised for his unmatched work ethic, complete game, faceoff excellence, and inspirational play. The team responds to adversity by continuing to play without deflating, a mindset led by veterans. The coaching staff emphasizes playing fast, making good puck decisions, avoiding the opponent’s transition game, and forcing the issue through skating. Phil is described as unflappable and a rare scoring threat who has produced timely goals. Geno is generating scoring chances and is expected to score soon, while Bryan is a game-time decision. Conor is having his minutes managed to preserve the quickness essential to his game, and he has developed greater comfort and consistency through experience and veteran mentorship. A defenseman is valued for his mobility, first-pass ability, offensive instincts, and situational deployment. The forward group is balanced, allowing any line to match opponents; Bones’ line is trusted against top lines because of its two-way awareness and offensive threat. Rusty is noted for his speed, tenacity, willingness to go to the net, and high confidence. The speaker reflects on his own coaching growth, noting that a player-development role provided perspective on NHL talent and reinforced the value of patience in developing young players.

Scientists from King’s College London analysed 49 studies with 266,939 people and found regular physical activity reduces depression risk for all ages and continents, even after accounting for BMI and smoking. They urge prioritising activity and policy changes to help everyone, including vulnerable members, engage.

Zacks Investment Research downgraded Caesars Entertainment Corporation (NASDAQ:CZR) from a buy rating to a hold rating. Analysts anticipate $0.06 EPS for the current fiscal year. "Four Down" is a basketball offense used for final-period shots and as a spread offense for talented ballhandlers; signaled by pointing four fingers down, it is also called "Four Low" or "Four Flat." Four players line the baseline with shooters in the corners, isolating the ballhandler to drive, shoot, or pass to an open post or corner if defenders help. Under pressure, corners pop out for release passes and may swap roles with the ballhandler. End-of-clock options include the Mid Screen, Triple Base Screen, and Misdirection Double, which use screens and handoffs to create layups, jump shots, or open three-point attempts.

Alex Ovechkin thanked teammates, coaches, and family for an award. He described a difficult year switching from left wing to right wing in the middle of the year at Adam's instruction, but feels back on track. He revealed he played through a broken foot from a blocked shot during the playoffs, only discovering the severity after his Russian national team did an MRI, because he believes players must play through injuries for the Stanley Cup. He noted his foot is recovering, he is working to get in shape, and remains committed to competing for the Stanley Cup.

The sense resistor senses transformer ripple current and shuts down the switching cycle if peak current exceeds the set limit; the CS pin voltage threshold is approximately 1 V. Figures 8-6, 8-7, and 8-8 show tests conducted with 48-V input and 10-A output, with the transient test stepping output current from 0 A to 10 A. The UC1825B-SP operates from a 10-V to 30-V well-regulated input and may require additional bulk capacitance if the supply is remote. It supports push-pull, forward, half-bridge, and full-bridge topologies. Low-EMI ferrite closed-core inductors are recommended. Layout guidelines include routing feedback traces away from the inductor on the opposite PCB side with a ground plane, placing input, output, and compensation components close to the IC, making power traces short and thick, using ground planes to reduce EMI, orienting switching current loops in the same direction, and separating high di/dt power ground from signal ground. Each output driver handles 2-A peak currents; VCC and VREF should be bypassed to their respective ground planes with ceramic capacitors.

The 2-3 zone is the most commonly used zone defense, aligning two guards above the free throw line, one post player in front of the basket, and two baseline players outside the three-second area. It protects the basket and stops dribble penetration, making it effective against poor outside shooting and dominant low post players, though vulnerable to good outside shooters. Often used by teams lacking quickness, it can also become an aggressive trapping defense with agile players. Defenders shift based on ball position, with outside guards covering sideline to sideline, the post guarding the low post, and baseline players working opposite with one always in a weakside rebounding position. Adjustments include wing defenders denying passes or helping the post, baseline defenders temporarily showing on ball reversal until guards recover, and a 1-1-3 tandem alignment. Trap options include corner, point, and automatic wing traps. Against exceptional tall post players, the defense uses pass denial and backside support to create double and triple teams.

News articles from late February 2001 report that California faces a severe summer electricity shortage, with supply expected to fall thousands of megawatts short of demand. Critics note Gov. Gray Davis is focusing on purchasing utility transmission lines and signing long-term power contracts rather than raising rates to reduce consumption. Other Western states, including Arizona, Nevada, and Utah, face similar shortages and are recalling power previously supplied to California. Construction of emergency "peaker" plants is stalled as state officials seek to revise contracts. A survey finds 40% of small California businesses view the state less favorably due to the crisis. Davis has taken a higher public profile, touring plants and pitching recovery plans. One report notes California ranks 49th in per-capita electricity consumption due to conservation and climate. Western spot power prices fell as several plants returned to service. Davis's transmission purchase plan faces legislative opposition over its cost and potential rate increases, while consumer groups criticize it as a utility bailout.

The New York Court of Appeals reversed lower court decisions and held that Manhattan Community Board 7 lacked the capacity to maintain a CPLR article 78 proceeding to compel the New York City Department of City Planning to disclose documents under the Freedom of Information Law. The Court distinguished capacity—a legislatively created entity’s power to appear and bring suit—from standing, noting that artificial governmental entities possess no inherent right to sue. Although community boards have an advisory role under the City Charter’s Uniform Land Use Review Procedure, the Court found no express or implied authorization to sue. The Charter’s specific document provisions and denial of subpoena power to boards, combined with legislative history showing the rejection of a proposed litigation grant during the 1975 Charter revision, evidenced legislative intent against such capacity. Because the board’s ULURP functions are purely advisory rather than enforcement-related, the power to sue is not a necessary implication of its statutory duties. Thus, despite FOIL’s broad standing provisions, the petition was dismissed.

The ADS9803 is an eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS data acquisition system with a built-in analog front-end. The device is powered down via the PWDN pin or by writing 11b to the PD_CH field in register bank 1, and requires an initialization sequence of register writes after power-up or reset with a free-running sampling clock connected. Registers are organized into three banks and default to initial values after initialization.

The device supports normal operation and a speed-boost mode allowing up to 8MSPS for a user-selected analog input channel pair. Configuration is performed via SPI by selecting register banks and writing to 16-bit registers; read access requires enabling SPI_RD_EN and SPI_MODE. Multiple devices can be configured in a daisy-chain topology, where the chain length is set in the DAISY_CHAIN_LEN register and operations require N × 24 SCLK cycles.

Key configurable parameters include analog input range, bandwidth, common-mode voltage, data interface lanes, data format, digital test patterns, averaging, and gain error correction. In automated test equipment applications, the ADS9803 achieves a post-calibration total unadjusted error of 0.0015% at 25°C ±5°C and offers wide-bandwidth mode for fast multiplexed signal settling. The device uses AVDD_5V, VDD_1V8, and IOVDD supplies with no required power-up sequence, and layout guidelines recommend isolating analog signals from digital noise with proper bypass capacitor placement.
